jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129291 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Recruitment Manage the end-to-end recruitment of interns across our various sites in Switzerland, covering all business functions. Partner closely with hiring managers from role briefing through candidate selection, interviews, offers, and hiring. Identify and leverage the most effective sourcing channels based on business needs, location, and hiring volume. Define relevant selection criteria tailored to each area of recruitment. Analyze recurring hiring needs and anticipate recruitment cycles across business functions to build proactive talent pipelines. Early Career Coordinate and represent the Group at career fairs, networking events, and employer branding initiatives with partner schools and universities. Participate in end-of-internship evaluations and ensure effective follow-up with early-career candidates. Design and continuously enhance the candidate experience for early talent before, during, and after their internship. Contribute to the continuous improvement and implementation of the Group’s Early Career strategy and related initiatives. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Final year Bachelor or Master's student in HR, Business Administration or related. Currently have an internship agreement (convention) with your school or university. Proficiency in office tools, specifically handling datas with Excel and comfortable with Powerpoint (MS Office Suite). A first experience in HR, ideally in recruitment or project management, is a strong asset. Knowledge of an ATS, ideally Workday, is a plus Fluent in French and English (spoken and written). Available for a 6-month internship. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, you will be invited for a first round of interview with the Talent Acquisition Partners, then a second round with the Swiss Early Careers & Campus Manager. Finally you will meet with the Head of Swiss Talent. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Swiss Talent Acquisition Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Senior Manager, Talent Corporate & Early Career, Cartier Save New York, United States of America Richemont Intl. Early Careers & Programs Senior Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Cartier

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129291 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Come Talent Acquisition & HR Projects Intern, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo dei nostri team e migliorare le nostre pratiche HR. La vostra missione si concentrerà su due aree principali: Talent Acquisition (60%) Potrai gestire il ciclo di reclutamento completo per le posizioni tirocinanti di Richemont in Svizzera attraverso le funzioni di supporto (Supply Chain, Finance, HR, IT, ecc) Collaborare con i manager per definire le esigenze di reclutamento. Identificare e fonte top candidati, conducendo una preselezione accurata. Organizzare e condurre interviste, assicurando un'esperienza candidato eccezionale. Fornire il follow-up a manager e candidati fino ad assumere il completamento. HR Project Management (40%) Contribuirai a iniziative strategiche finalizzate ad attrarre e migliorare l'esperienza dei nostri giovani talenti. Partecipa attivamente all'organizzazione di eventi di reclutamento con Richemont Group e scuole mirate. Rappresenta Richemont in fiere di carriera e eventi di networking. Contribuire a sviluppare e mantenere forti relazioni con le scuole e le università partner. Partecipa al miglioramento continuo del nostro programma di tirocinio e alla strategia di Early Career Management. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Attualmente perseguire un master (o equivalente) e alla ricerca di uno stage di 6 mesi, a partire dal luglio 2026. Una prima esperienza in Risorse Umane, idealmente nel reclutamento o nella gestione del progetto, è un vantaggio. Competenza negli strumenti di ufficio (MS Office Suite). Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, con la capacità di interagire efficacemente a tutti i livelli. Fluente in francese e inglese (spoken e scritto). Proattivo, organizzato, con un ottimo senso di servizio e di iniziativa. Che cosa fa la nostra unione di gruppo? Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. Incoraggiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità. Ci impegniamo a prenderci cura del mondo in cui viviamo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Senior Manager, Talent Corporate & Early Career, Cartier Save New York, Stati Uniti d'America Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Benelux & Nordics Save Amsterdam, Paesi Bassi Richemont Talent Acquisition Partner Save Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont

jobs.title: Procurement Category Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129333 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for a Procurement Category Manager dedicated to Corporate Services categories. Reporting to the Category Director Corporate & Operations, you will be responsible for developing and driving comprehensive global category strategies as well as supporting our Central Functions, Maisons and Regions Procurement community to optimize sourcing and supplier management for your categories. This role is instrumental in ensuring optimal value creation and cost efficiency, through category expertise, market knowledge, strong internal and external relationship management. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Procurement Category Manager, your main responsibilities will include: Global Category Strategy Development & Leadership: Develop, define, and implement comprehensive global category strategies aligned with Richemont’s (Group/Maisons/Regions) business needs & Objectives. Lead the execution and roll-out of category strategies across various Maisons and regions through business partnering, stakeholders enrolling and influencing. Drive value creation, cost reduction, and innovation across the assigned categories through deep market knowledge, category expertise, and a forward-thinking approach. Sourcing, Market Intelligence & Supplier Relationship Management Manage complex tenders, negotiations, and contract management for global and central agreements, ensuring favorable terms and conditions. Conduct market analysis and competitive intelligence for the assigned category. Develop and maintain comprehensive knowledge of the global supplier landscape, identifying strategic partners and emerging suppliers. Develop and implement strategic SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) programs for key suppliers, fostering long-term partnerships. Lead regular strategic business reviews with critical suppliers to drive continuous improvement and innovation. Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key internal stakeholders across functions, Maisons and Regions to understand business needs and ensure category strategies support overall business goals. Act as a trusted advisor to internal clients on procurement best practices, market insights, and supplier capabilities. Support central functions sourcing needs for central spend & global initiatives. Performance Management & Compliance: Monitor category performance, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and report on progress against strategic objectives and financial targets. Ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and sourcing process rules, ethical guidelines, and external regulations. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are an established and versatile procurement professional with 7+ years of experience in a structured environment, with strong category management skills. Experience and knowledge within the Corporate services area, ideally Security and Facilities Management categories, is an advantage. You have: Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated ability to develop and implement global category strategies, driving significant value creation, cost optimization, and innovation. RFPs, Negotiation & Contract Management: Excellent RFP, negotiation and contract management abilities, with a proven track record of securing advantageous terms. Stakeholder Management: Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, capable of engaging effectively with diverse internal and external partners at all levels, including senior leadership. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and creative solutions. Adaptability: Demonstrated learning agility and adaptability to evolving market conditions and business needs. Autonomy & Drive: Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, getting the buy-in from stakeholders and leading execution. Proactive, results-oriented, and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international, and demanding environment. Sustainability Focus: A strong commitment to responsible sourcing and integrating sustainability principles into procurement practices. Academics: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, Marketing and Professional certifications. Languages: Fluent in both English and French. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Piaget IT Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Procurement Manager Save Amsterdam, Netherlands Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR129460 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. WERDE AUCH DU NEXT IWC XPERT! Unsere Berufsausbildung richtet sich an begeisterungsfähige Jugendliche, die ihre Zukunft mit viel Leidenschaft gestalten möchten. Mit einer Lehre bei IWC legst du den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche berufliche Laufbahn. Eine Lehre bei uns fordert dich heraus – und fördert deine individuellen Fähigkeiten und Talente. HIER TICKST DU GENAU RICHTIG! Du hast Freude an Präzisionsarbeit und möchtest dein handwerkliches Geschick einsetzen? Du hast Interesse an technischen Zusammenhängen und an der Funktionsweise einer Uhr? Du hast Spass daran, ein Uhrengehäuse zu öffnen und das Uhrwerk in seine Bestandteile zu zerlegen? Du bist ein Teamplayer und setzt deine erlernten Fähigkeiten in einem Team ein? Du überzeugst durch Geduld und eine gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise? Dann haben wir die passende Lehrstelle für dich! DEINE AUFGABEN Während deiner Lehre vermitteln wir dir ein umfassendes fachliches Rüstzeug: Grundlagenschulung in der IWC Lehrwerkstatt Einblick in die verschiedenen Montageabteilungen von der Bestandteilherstellung bis zur Endmontage Uhrwerkmontage Reparatur von einfachen Uhren DEINE FÄHIGKEITEN UND TALENTE Oberste Schulstufe (Sek A, Niveau E) Gute bis sehr gute Leistungen in Mathematik und in Natur & Technik Interesse an geometrischem oder technischem Zeichnen Technisches Verständnis und handwerkliches Geschick Ausgeprägtes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen DIE HIGHLIGHTS BEI IWC Spannende Einführungswoche für einen gelungenen Start Übernahme GA-Kosten sowie finanzielle Unterstützung bei Schulmaterial und vollständige Kostenübernahme von Sprachaufenthalten Jährlicher Lernendenausflug und viele weitere Firmenevents Täglich CHF 7.– Verpflegungsbeitrag für die Kantine und ausgewählte Restaurants in Schaffhausen Monatlicher Zuschuss von CHF 195.– an deine Krankenkassenprämie 40-Stunden-Woche, bis zu 7 Wochen Ferien und 5 zusätzliche Überbrückungstage Leistungsprämie ab dem 2. jobs.title: Internal Warehouse (Senior) Product Owner
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129522 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Drive the future of Warehousing execution in a Global Luxury leader. As a Product Owner, You will shape digital solutions powering inbound, outbound and in-warehouse activities. At the crossroad of operations and technology, you will lead Warehouse management solutions evolution, automation and innovation at scale.” YOUR MISSION: As part of the Group Platforms department, Richemont is looking to strengthen a very dynamic Group Product Management team. The Product team is structured around key capabilities that support our Maisons’ value chain strategy. Logistics at Richemont cover worldwide internal and external warehousing activities, transportation and customs-related activities. The Internal Warehousing (Senior) Product Owner (PO) is responsible for defining, delivering, and continuously improving digital products supporting warehouse operations worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of operations, technology, and business, ensuring that warehousing capabilities (inbound, outbound, in-warehouse processes, and reverse logistics) are efficient, scalable, and aligned with the company’s high standards of service and traceability. The Internal Warehousing (Senior) Product Owner (PO) will ensure alignment with Richemont Group logistics strategy and regional specificities and acts as the voice of warehouse operations within the product organization. He/She will materialize the product strategy, prioritizing features to deliver the best possible outcomes for our clients and / or end-users in full alignment with Group Logistics business priorities, complying with business rules and processes defined by the Business Process Owners (BPOs). The Senior Internal Warehousing PO plays a key role in supporting the Group Logistics strategy by driving the development of valuable products. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will act as the Business-Product Team interface, collaborating with Group Logistics and other business stakeholders. You will develop and promote the Product vision, own the product roadmap and budget and be responsible for managing the product throughout its lifecycle. You will define product objectives and key results (OKR). You will collaborate with Group Functions / other business stakeholders to discover and understand their needs, translating these into product requirements. You will prioritize demand in close collaboration with the business stakeholders (Maisons, Functions and Regions/countries senior management). You will maintain and refine product backlog based on changing needs according to business value or ROI, given capacity available. You will partner with the Technology teams to make sure the product vision is translated appropriately into the implementation. You will align with cross-functional teams to manage cross-product dependencies. You will work with the Product Team to ensure selected technologies match requirements expressed by business stakeholders (Maisons, Functions, Regions/countries) You will be responsible for product adoption, delivering product training support and documents. You will support business performing change management and sharing best practices You will conduct regular updates to share how the product/s is/are evolving and to demonstrate how they contribute to the business vision and to the success of Richemont and its Maisons. You will continuously seek to improve products to meet Business outcomes, tracking user feedback, benefits, adoption and usage through key metrics / KPIs. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Excellence is a top priority for our teams. On this role, you have the occasion to play a pivotal role in the development of the Group core operations. Your passion for moving forward and achieving will find the perfect context within the team. Innovation is at the heart of what we do, joining us means being exposed to the latest trends and technologies. DIMENSIONS 5-10 years’ experience in products management, including multinational and innovative environments. B.Sc. or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a master’s degree in business 5+ years in Warehouse operations and omnichannel distribution models Strong expertise in Warehousing solutions stack implementation (WMS, WCS, IoT, etc.) and composable architecture Excellent Business acumen, strong customer orientation. Successful experience in facilitation, change management, and cross-business areas problem-solving. Knowledge of collaborative solutions for product management and Agile frameworks/methodologies. Experience in implementing PO techniques (e.g., customer journeys, personas, discovery, agile ceremonies). Ability to anticipate change through technologies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and organizational skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, good listener. Ability to present ideas in a user-friendly or executive language at different management levels up to C-Level, motivate and inspire teams with client vision. Experience working in a team-oriented and collaborative environment. Proficiency in English is mandatory. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Finance Senior Product Owner Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Clienteling Product Management Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Internal Warehousing Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Group People Analytics Director
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129438 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for an experienced and forward-thinking leader to shape the next chapter of Group People Analytics. In this role, you will define and drive our People Analytics and HR Reporting strategy, strengthen data-informed decision-making across HR and business leadership, and accelerate our ability to unlock the value of people data at scale. You will play a pivotal role in transforming HR into a more insight-led function while ensuring our data, platforms, and capabilities evolve to support strategic, operational, and regulatory needs across the Group. Reporting to the Group HR Digital & Data Director, you will lead the Group People Analytics function and a team of four experts. You will shape the function’s direction, strengthen its operating model, and ensure the delivery of impactful executive insights and scalable reporting capabilities for the Group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will position People Analytics as a strategic capability for HR and the business, combining leadership, business partnership, and analytical expertise. In particular, you will: Define and lead the Group People Analytics and Reporting strategy, setting the vision, priorities, governance, and roadmap required to strengthen data-driven decision-making across HR and for business leaders. Lead the adoption and continuous improvement of the Visier people analytics platform, ensuring relevance of insights, strong user experience, and growing usage across the HR community and, progressively, among business leaders. Strengthen the analytics capabilities of the HR community through targeted upskilling and stronger data literacy, enabling them to translate complex workforce topics into clear, decision-oriented narratives. Shape the future HR data and analytics ecosystem leveraging our data lake capabilities with GCP and Looker, enabling richer analysis across people and business data. Drive excellence in Workday reporting by establishing a robust operating model that combines clear governance, strong expertise, reliable delivery, and the ability to scale reporting services efficiently across the Group. Own HR data governance end-to-end, covering stewardship, data quality, definitions, documentation, compliance, and controls, while guiding the continuous strengthening of data quality practices. Deliver high-value executive insights for Group leadership and provide trusted data for Non-Financial Reporting and other regulatory requirements. Animate the People Analytics community across the Group, fostering alignment, knowledge sharing, and the spread of effective practices. Operate effectively across both strategic priorities and key tactical matters, ensuring the function remains connected to business needs while driving long-term direction. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of experts, ensuring strong execution, collaboration, and continuous growth of the function. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Master’s degree in a relevant field and 15+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR data, reporting, or related analytics domains, including successful experience in a similar senior leadership role. Strong track record in defining and executing People Analytics strategies that create measurable business value and strengthen HR effectiveness. Proven leadership capability, with experience coaching, developing, and inspiring multidisciplinary expert teams while setting high standards for quality, pace, and collaboration. Strong ability to translate complex people and business data into clear messages, practical recommendations, and compelling executive narratives. Deep understanding of HR data, data governance, data quality, reporting models, and the responsibilities that come with handling sensitive employee information. Solid expertise in Workday reporting and strong familiarity with modern analytics platforms and ecosystems, including Visier, GCP, and Looker. Experience designing adoption strategies and upskilling programs that strengthen analytics literacy and encourage effective use of data across HR communities. Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across HR, Group Platform, Finance, and senior business stakeholders in a matrix organization. Excellent communication skills and executive presence, with the credibility to influence senior stakeholders and represent the function at Group level. Fluent in English; French is an asset. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group HR Reporting Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Director, Talent Management & Mobility Save New York, United States of America Cartier Group Procurement Data and Analytics Senior Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Coordinateur Formation Manufacturing - CDD
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129589 POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante. Prenez part à notre succès collectif et à la création de notre héritage futur. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON Les équipes de la Formation Métiers assurent la formation initiale des apprentis et apportent une expertise dans le cadre du déploiement des plans de formation des équipes de production et service après-vente afin de répondre aux enjeux d’agilité, de performance et de qualité de la Maison. En tant que Spécialiste Formation Métiers, vous pilotez la formation des équipes de production Manufacturing en collaboration avec les directions de production, les responsables d’atelier, les experts métiers et les formateurs. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER Vous pilotez la construction du plan de formation des équipes de production Manufacturing en collaborations avec les responsables d’atelier et la direction afin de répondre aux enjeux de polyvalence, de sécurisation des activités, de développement personnel et d’employabilité. Vous mettez en place le cadre permettant le bon déroulement et le bon suivi (KPIs notamment) des formations en autonomie par les responsables d’atelier. L’optimisation et le déploiement d’outils digitaux de gestion des formations et des compétences feront partie de vos objectifs. Vous construisez et mettez à jour certains supports de formation en vous appuyant sur les experts métiers. Vous diffusez les bonnes méthodes pédagogiques afin de faire évoluer les formateurs puis d’améliorer la qualité et l’’efficacité des formations. Vous pilotez et/ou participez à des projets en lien avec les compétences, que ce soit dans leur identification, leur développement ou leur valorisation. Vous travaillez en continue sur l’accompagnement des équipes managériales afin d’optimiser leur gestion des compétences et de renforcer leur autonomie. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129589 PER LA SEARCH DI ESCELLENCE Unisciti a una delle iconiche case dell'alta orologeria, dove l'eccellenza è un requisito costante. IL TUO RUOLO DI PIÙ Conduci la costruzione del piano di formazione del team di produzione manifatturiera in collaborazione con i responsabili del workshop e la gestione per affrontare questioni di versatilità, sicurezza aziendale, sviluppo personale e occupabilità. Hai impostato il quadro per il buon funzionamento e il buon follow-up (KPI in particolare) delle formazioni in autonomia da parte dei responsabili del workshop. Ottimizzare e distribuire strumenti di formazione digitale e di gestione delle competenze sarà parte dei vostri obiettivi. Costruisci e aggiorni alcuni materiali formativi basandoti su esperti professionali. Si diffondono i metodi di insegnamento giusti per sviluppare i formatori e migliorare la qualità e l'efficacia della formazione. Condurre e/o partecipare a progetti relativi alle competenze, sia nella loro identificazione, sviluppo o valorizzazione. Stai lavorando continuamente sul supporto dei team di gestione al fine di ottimizzare la loro gestione delle competenze e rafforzare la loro autonomia. QUALITÀ DI ESCELLENTE Hai un'esperienza di successo nella costruzione e nel monitoraggio dei piani di formazione, nonché nella gestione del progetto, idealmente in un ambiente tecnico. Con un eccellente rapporto, hai la capacità di supportare i team manageriali, rendendoli autonomi nella gestione delle competenze dei loro team. Siete guidati dalla trasmissione del know-how e affidatevi a forti competenze pedagogiche, sviluppate come parte del vostro percorso formativo e/o di carriera. Hai anche una grande facilità con strumenti digitali. Molto confortevole in francese, con un buon livello in inglese, sei una comunicazione eccellente e sai come costruire e fornire presentazioni di impatto. Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, la nostra Casa gestisce una rete mondiale di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità – orologiai, artigiani e professionisti – condivide la stessa passione per il nostro patrimonio e l'ambizione di costruire un futuro ancora più luminoso. descriptionByLocale.de: Bezugscode: JR129589 FÜR DIE, DIE AUF EXZELLENZ ERSUCHEN Treten Sie einem der ikonischen Häuser der hohen Uhrmacherei bei, in denen Exzellenz eine ständige Anforderung ist. Nehmen Sie teil an unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und der Schaffung unseres zukünftigen Erbes. Dein Grund, im Haus zu sein Die Trades Training Teams bieten eine Erstausbildung für Auszubildende und bieten Fachwissen im Rahmen der Bereitstellung von Schulungsplänen für Produktionsteams und After-Sales-Services, um den Herausforderungen der Agilität, Leistung und Qualität des Hauses gerecht zu werden. Als Trade Training Specialist leiten Sie die Ausbildung von Produktionsteams in Zusammenarbeit mit Produktionsleitern, Werkstattleitern, Handelsexperten und Trainern. DEINE ROLLE ZU SPIELEN Sie leiten den Aufbau des Schulungsplans für das Produktionsteam in Zusammenarbeit mit Werkstattleitern und dem Management, um Fragen der Vielseitigkeit, der Geschäftssicherheit, der persönlichen Entwicklung und der Beschäftigungsfähigkeit anzugehen. Sie setzen den Rahmen für einen reibungslosen Ablauf und eine gute Nachverfolgung (insbesondere KPIs) der autonomen Schulungen durch die Werkstattleiter. Die Optimierung und Bereitstellung digitaler Schulungs- und Kompetenzmanagement-Tools wird Teil Ihrer Ziele sein. Sie erstellen und aktualisieren einige Schulungsmaterialien, indem Sie sich auf professionelle Experten verlassen. Sie verbreiten die richtigen Lehrmethoden, um Trainer zu entwickeln und die Qualität und Effektivität der Ausbildung zu verbessern. Sie leiten und / oder beteiligen sich an Projekten im Zusammenhang mit Fähigkeiten, sei es bei deren Identifizierung, Entwicklung oder Verbesserung. Sie arbeiten kontinuierlich an der Unterstützung von Managementteams, um ihr Management von Fähigkeiten zu optimieren und ihre Autonomie zu stärken. AUSSCHREIBUNGSQUALITÄTEN Sie haben eine erfolgreiche Erfahrung im Aufbau und Monitoring von Schulungsplänen sowie im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in einem technischen Umfeld. Neugierig, haben Sie eine Eignung für technische Trades und eine Leichtigkeit, ihre Besonderheiten zu verstehen. Eine Betriebserfahrung von Produktionsstationen in der Industrie ist ein Gewinn. Mit einer hervorragenden Beziehung haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Führungsteams zu unterstützen und sie bei der Verwaltung der Fähigkeiten ihrer Teams autonom zu machen. Sie werden von der Vermittlung von Know-how angetrieben und verlassen sich auf starke pädagogische Fähigkeiten, die im Rahmen Ihrer Ausbildung und / oder Ihres Karrierewegs entwickelt wurden. Sie haben auch große Leichtigkeit mit digitalen Tools. Sehr komfortabel in französisch, mit einem guten niveau in englisch, sind sie eine ausgezeichnete kommunikation und wissen, wie man wirkungsvolle präsentationen erstellt und liefert. Vacheron Constantin feierte 270 Jahre als älteste Uhrenfabrik der Welt, die seit 1755 ununterbrochen in Betrieb ist. Mit Sitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreibt unser Haus ein weltweites Netzwerk von fast 200 Filialen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen Gemeinschaft - Uhrmacher, Handwerker und Profis - teilt die gleiche Leidenschaft für unser Erbe und den Ehrgeiz, eine noch bessere Zukunft aufzubauen. Arbeitsplatz: Plan-les-Ouates & Le Brassus Bereit, Teil unserer Geschichte zu sein? Wir freuen uns, Ihre Anwendung zu entdecken. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129680 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As an intern within the Group Supply Chain Solution team, reporting to the Data Manager, you will play a crucial role in shaping the future of our Supply Chain data & analytics strategy. This involves: Collaborating closely with Richemont Maisons to identify and design key performance indicators, translating business needs into actionable data insights. Developing and implementing data-driven solutions that improves Supply Chain efficiency and visibility, leveraging your analytical and technical skills, within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment. Facilitating the successful adoption of new solutions by preparing comprehensive training materials, validating functionalities with users, and providing hands-on support during operational implementation. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE? We are looking for an enthusiastic and analytical intern who possesses: A strong passion for data analytics and an interest in exploring the Supply Chain from the performance perspective. Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with an aptitude for interpreting complex data. Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Looker. Knowledge of SQL and Python is a strong asset. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with users, contributing to the design and implementation of data-driven solutions. A first experience in data analytics, preferably within a Supply Chain context. Fluency in French and English is required. Start date + availability 6 months HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains. You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two thousand years of heritage with cutting edge innovation. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Geneva, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. The offices are close to local transport with direct access to the train station. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Knowledge Management Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Operational Excellence Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Cartier

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129680 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In qualità di stagista all'interno del team Group Supply Chain Solution, segnalando al Data Manager, svolgerai un ruolo cruciale nella definizione del futuro della nostra strategia di analisi dei dati e dei dati della Supply Chain. Ciò comporta: collaborare a stretto contatto con Richemont Maisons per identificare e progettare indicatori chiave di performance, traducendo le esigenze aziendali in insight di dati attuabili. Sviluppare e implementare soluzioni basate sui dati che migliorano l'efficienza e la visibilità della Supply Chain, sfruttando le tue competenze analitiche e tecniche, all'interno dell'ambiente Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Facilitare l'adozione di nuove soluzioni attraverso la preparazione di materiali di formazione completi, la validazione delle funzionalità con gli utenti e la fornitura di supporto pratico durante l'implementazione operativa. Cosa vuoi fare in questo ruolo? Siamo alla ricerca di uno stage entusiasta e analitico che possiede: una forte passione per l'analisi dei dati e un interesse ad esplorare la Supply Chain dal punto di vista delle prestazioni. Competenze analitiche e problem solving solide, con un'attitudine per interpretare dati complessi. Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione dati come Power BI o Looker. La conoscenza di SQL e Python è un bene forte. Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali per collaborare efficacemente con gli utenti, contribuendo alla progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni basate sui dati. Una prima esperienza nell'analisi dei dati, preferibilmente all'interno di un contesto Supply Chain. È richiesta una fluidità in francese e inglese. Data d'inizio + disponibilità 6 mesi COME ESPERIENZA SUCESS CON noi? Potrai lavorare con diverse squadre e avere l'opportunità di conoscere una vasta gamma di domini. Si otterrà intuizioni nel settore del lusso dalla prospettiva di uno dei leader globali che sta bridging più di duemila anni di patrimonio con innovazione all'avanguardia. Lavorando nei pressi della campagna svizzera proprio fuori Ginevra, offriamo un ristorante in loco, una splendida cornice e un ampio ambiente di lavoro a pianta aperta. Gli uffici sono vicini al trasporto locale con accesso diretto alla stazione ferroviaria. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Supply Chain Intern Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Supply Chain Intern Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR129654 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT: The Group Product & Trade Compliance department (GPTC) aims to prevent the Group and its Maisons from supply chain disruption and brand reputation damage stemming from regulatory non-compliance. Within the GPTC department, GPTC Data & Operations Excellence team is responsible to manage and orchestrate the best strategy & solutions to ensure Product & Trade Compliance effectiveness within the Group. The mission consists in leveraging best-in-class processes, organization, technology & Data Management implementation and supporting efficient end-to-end operational solutions across Functions, Maisons, and Regions for Compliance effectiveness while decreasing the most possible constraints on impacted processes and organization. In this context, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert leverages a thorough knowledge of our Corporate Trade Compliance Processes & Data to support and accompany our colleagues and partners. He ensures the appropriate Trade Compliance processes, their formalization and optimization on the diversity of global trade activities such import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc. He ensures day-to-day the corresponding knowledge transfer through training or consulting to our internal stakeholders’ community to supports their operations across end-to-end value chain. Co-warrant of our Group compliance effectiveness & control tower, the role is as well instrumental in relevant KPI monitoring, data quality stewardship and suboptimal process identification. When necessary, this will lead to conduct root-cause analyses and the corresponding continuous improvement initiatives for ensuring the robustness and performance of our processes on the long run. Ultimately, thanks to its expertise, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert is eventually acting as a Subject Matter Expert or Stream Lead into broader projects led under other’s entity leadership. YOUR MISSION: Ensure process formalization and process optimization on global trade compliance scope (import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc.). This mission includes the corresponding data management guidelines. Ensure support and consulting service for our internal stakeholders’ community on Trade compliance data and processes. Conduct training in processes and system-driven solutions in place to empower people. Analyse support demand for Trade Compliance implementation solution concerning system and data under our process ownership and conduct the appropriate enhancement or initiative framing to deliver effective & efficient solution. Monitor & Analyse Trade Compliance KPI and act as a Trade Compliance Data Quality Control Tower. Perform data stewardship for data contributed by our stakeholders (Maisons, Group, Region) that are under our responsibility and covered by our Data Governance. Conduct root cause analyze and continuous process improvements initiative Support in projects that require our PTC data management & process expertise. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT: At least 3 years’ experience in an international environment in the field of Trade Compliance Comfortable with Supply Chain & Trade regulatory domain area (HS Commodity Codes, Regulatory documentation & policies interpretation, International Logistics Operational flows,..) Experience in Business Analysis, Process Management or Project Management an advantage Meticulous and very detailed-oriented Comfortable with Digital & IT systems logic and software user interface (good understanding of SAP and SAP GTS a plus). General proficiency with Excel (data manipulation, export, filters, Xlookup, pivot table, etc.) A kind, consultative and cooperative way of interacting. A sense of Customer focus A proactive mindset in challenging the status quo and supporting continuous pragmatic improvement initiatives Fluent in French, Full Proficient in English due the daily interaction with multi-cultural stakeholders. Speaking Italian and/or German a serious plus #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Trade Compliance Expert Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Vendor Master Data Specialist Save Milano, Italy Richemont Import/Export Specialist (1yr Contract) Save Seoul, Korea, Republic of Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129654 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. CONTEXT: Il Gruppo Product & Trade Compliance (GPTC) ha lo scopo di impedire al Gruppo e alle sue Maison la rottura della supply chain e la reputazione del marchio derivante dalla non conformità normativa. All'interno del dipartimento GPTC, il team di GPTC Data & Operations Excellence è responsabile della gestione e dell'orchestrazione delle migliori soluzioni strategiche e per garantire l'efficacia di Product & Trade Compliance all'interno del Gruppo. La missione consiste nel sfruttare l'implementazione di processi, organizzazione, tecnologia e gestione dei dati e nel supportare soluzioni operative end-to-end efficienti su Funzioni, Maison e Regioni per l'efficacia della conformità, riducendo al contempo i vincoli più possibili sui processi e sull'organizzazione con impatto. In questo contesto, il Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert sfrutta una conoscenza approfondita dei nostri processi di compliance aziendale e dati per supportare e accompagnare i nostri colleghi e partner. Assicura i processi di Compliance commerciale appropriati, la loro formalizzazione e ottimizzazione sulla diversità delle attività commerciali globali quali l'importazione, l'esportazione, procedure speciali, dazi & FTA, ecc. Garantisce ogni giorno il trasferimento di conoscenze corrispondente attraverso la formazione o la consulenza alla comunità degli stakeholder interni per sostenere le loro operazioni attraverso la catena del valore end-to-end. Co-guerra del nostro Gruppo efficacia di conformità & torre di controllo, il ruolo è anche strumentale nel monitoraggio KPI rilevante, gestione della qualità dei dati e identificazione del processo suboptimale. Se necessario, questo porterà a condurre analisi causa radice e le corrispondenti iniziative di miglioramento continuo per garantire la robustezza e le prestazioni dei nostri processi a lungo termine. In definitiva, grazie alla sua esperienza, il Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert è alla fine agire come un Oggetto Matter Expert o Stream Lead in progetti più ampi condotti sotto la leadership di altri enti. TUA MISSIONE: Assicurare la formalizzazione del processo e l'ottimizzazione del processo sul campo di conformità del commercio globale (importazione, esportazione, procedure speciali, doveri & FTA, ecc.). Questa missione include le corrispondenti linee guida per la gestione dei dati. Assicurare il supporto e il servizio di consulenza per la comunità degli stakeholder interni sui dati e processi di conformità al commercio. Condurre la formazione in processi e soluzioni orientate al sistema in atto per potenziare le persone. Analizzare la domanda di supporto per la soluzione di implementazione Trade Compliance relativa al sistema e ai dati in base alla nostra proprietà di processo e condurre l'appropriato potenziamento o l'inquadratura di iniziativa per fornire una soluzione efficace ed efficiente. Monitorare e analizzare la conformità commerciale KPI e fungere da Trade Compliance Data Quality Control Tower. Eseguire la gestione dei dati per i dati forniti dai nostri stakeholder (Maisons, Group, Region) che sono sotto la nostra responsabilità e coperti dalla nostra governance dei dati. Condurre radice causa analizzare e continuo processo miglioramenti iniziativa Supporto in progetti che richiedono la nostra gestione dei dati PTC e competenze di processo. HOW WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in un ambiente internazionale nel campo della conformità commerciale Confortevole con la Supply Chain & Trade area di dominio regolamentare (Codici di commodicità, documentazione regolamentare e interpretazione delle politiche, Flussi operativi della logistica internazionale,..) Esperienza nell'analisi aziendale, nella gestione dei processi o nella gestione dei progetti un vantaggio Meticoloso e molto dettagliato Confortevole con la logica dei sistemi informatici e l'interfaccia utente software (buona comprensione di SAP e SAP GTS a plus). Proficienza generale con Excel ( manipolazione dei dati, esportazione, filtri, Xlookup, tabella pivot, ecc.) Un modo gentile, consultivo e cooperativo di interagire. Una mentalità proattiva nel sfidare lo status quo e sostenere continue iniziative di miglioramento pragmatico Fluent in French, Full Proficient in English a causa dell'interazione quotidiana con gli stakeholder multi-culturali. Parlando italiano e/o tedesco un serio plus #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Compliance Process & Data Expert Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Trade Compliance Expert Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Logistics & Trade Compliance Manager Save Sydney, Australia Richemont

descriptionByLocale.de: Bezugscode: JR129654 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter Maisons, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, feinen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jede Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jeder seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovationen und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. Die Group Product & Trade Compliance-Abteilung (GPTC) zielt darauf ab, die Gruppe und ihre Maisons vor Lieferkettenstörungen und Markenreputationsschäden zu bewahren, die sich aus der Nichteinhaltung von Vorschriften ergeben. Innerhalb der GPTC-Abteilung ist das GPTC Data & Operations Excellence-Team dafür verantwortlich, die beste Strategie und Lösungen zu verwalten und zu orchestrieren, um die Wirksamkeit von Product & Trade Compliance innerhalb der Gruppe zu gewährleisten. Die Mission besteht darin, erstklassige Prozesse, Organisation, Technologie- und Datenmanagement-Implementierungen zu nutzen und effiziente End-to-End-Betriebslösungen für die Compliance-Effektivität in Funktionen, Maisons und Regionen zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig die größtmöglichen Einschränkungen für betroffene Prozesse und Organisationen zu verringern. In diesem Zusammenhang nutzt der Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert eine gründliche Kenntnis unserer Corporate Trade Compliance Prozesse & Daten, um unsere Kollegen und Partner zu unterstützen und zu begleiten. Er sorgt für die entsprechenden Trade-Compliance-Prozesse, deren Formalisierung und Optimierung auf die Vielfalt der globalen Handelsaktivitäten wie Import, Export, spezielle Verfahren, Pflichten & FTA, etc. Er sichert täglich den entsprechenden Wissenstransfer durch Schulungen oder Beratung an die interne Stakeholder-Community, um deren Betrieb über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette hinweg zu unterstützen. Co-Warrant unseres Group Compliance Effectiveness & Control Towers, die Rolle ist auch entscheidend für die relevante KPI-Überwachung, die Datenqualität und die suboptimale Prozessidentifizierung. Dies führt bei Bedarf zu Ursachenanalysen und entsprechenden kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen, um die Robustheit und Performance unserer Prozesse langfristig sicherzustellen. Letztendlich agiert der Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert dank seiner Expertise als Subject Matter Expert oder Stream Lead in breitere Projekte, die unter der Führung anderer Unternehmen geführt werden. IHRE MISSION: Sicherstellen der Prozessformalisierung und Prozessoptimierung im Rahmen der Einhaltung des globalen Handels (Import, Export, Sonderverfahren, Zölle und Freihandelsabkommen usw.). Diese Mission beinhaltet die entsprechenden Datenmanagement-Richtlinien. Sicherstellen von Support und Beratungsservice für unsere interne Stakeholder-Community zu Compliance-Daten und -Prozessen. Führen Sie Schulungen zu Prozessen und systemgesteuerten Lösungen durch, um Menschen zu stärken. Analysieren Sie die Nachfrage nach Trade Compliance-Implementierungslösungen in Bezug auf System und Daten unter unserem Prozesseigentum und führen Sie die entsprechende Verbesserung oder Initiative durch, um eine effektive und effiziente Lösung zu liefern. Monitoring & Analyse Trade Compliance KPI und fungieren als Trade Compliance Data Quality Control Tower. Führen Sie Datenverwaltung für Daten durch, die von unseren Stakeholdern (Maisons, Group, Region) bereitgestellt werden, die unter unserer Verantwortung stehen und von unserer Data Governance abgedeckt werden. Durchführung von Ursachenanalysen und kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserungen in Projekten, die unsere PTC-Datenmanagement- und Prozesskompetenz erfordern. WIE WIRDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN: Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einem internationalen Umfeld im Bereich Trade Compliance Komfortabel mit Supply Chain & Trade regulatorischen Bereich (HS Commodity Codes, Regulatory Documentation & Policy Interpretation, International Logistics Operational Flows, ...) Erfahrung in Business Analysis, Prozessmanagement oder Projektmanagement ein Vorteil sorgfältig und sehr detailorientiert Komfortabel mit Digital & IT-Systemlogik und Software-Benutzeroberfläche (gutes Verständnis von SAP und SAP GTS ein Plus). Allgemeine Kenntnisse mit Excel (Datenmanipulation, Export, Filter, Xlookup, Pivot-Tabelle, etc.) Eine freundliche, beratende und kooperative Art der Interaktion. Eine proaktive Denkweise bei der Herausforderung des Status quo und der Unterstützung kontinuierlicher pragmatischer Verbesserungsinitiativen, die fließend Französisch, voll auf Englisch durch die tägliche Interaktion mit multikulturellen Stakeholdern sprechen. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. En même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs de Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. CONTEXTE : Le service de conformité des produits et du commerce du Groupe (GPTC) vise à empêcher le Groupe et ses Maisons de perturber la chaîne d'approvisionnement et de nuire à la réputation de la marque en raison de la non-conformité réglementaire. Au sein du département GPTC, l'équipe d'excellence en données et opérations GPTC est chargée de gérer et d'orchestrer la meilleure stratégie et solutions pour assurer l'efficacité de la conformité aux produits et au commerce au sein du Groupe. La mission consiste à mettre à profit les meilleurs processus de classe, l'organisation, la technologie et la gestion des données et à soutenir des solutions opérationnelles efficaces de bout en bout dans l'ensemble des fonctions, des maisons et des régions pour assurer l'efficacité de la conformité, tout en réduisant les contraintes les plus possibles sur les processus et l'organisation touchés. Dans ce contexte, l'expert en processus et données de conformité commerciale tire parti d'une connaissance approfondie de nos processus et données de conformité commerciale pour soutenir et accompagner nos collègues et partenaires. Il assure les processus appropriés de conformité commerciale, leur formalisation et leur optimisation sur la diversité des activités commerciales mondiales telles que l'importation, l'exportation, les procédures spéciales, les droits et l'ALE, etc. Il assure au jour le jour le transfert des connaissances correspondantes par la formation ou la consultation auprès de nos intervenants internes, afin de soutenir leurs activités dans toute la chaîne de valeur de bout en bout. Co-hérent de notre tour de contrôle et d'efficacité de la conformité du Groupe, le rôle est également déterminant dans la surveillance pertinente de l'ICP, la gérance de la qualité des données et l'identification des processus sous-optimaux. Au besoin, cela mènera à des analyses de causes profondes et à des initiatives d'amélioration continue correspondantes pour assurer la robustesse et la performance de nos processus à long terme. En fin de compte, grâce à son expertise, l'expert en processus de conformité commerciale et données agit éventuellement à titre d'expert en matière de questions ou de chef de file dans des projets plus vastes menés sous la direction d'autres entités. VOTRE MISSION: Assurer la formalisation du processus et l'optimisation du processus sur la portée de la conformité au commerce mondial (importation, exportation, procédures spéciales, droits et ALE, etc.). Cette mission comprend les directives correspondantes en matière de gestion des données. Assurer un service de soutien et de consultation à nos intervenants internes en ce qui concerne les données et les processus de conformité commerciale. Mener une formation sur les processus et les solutions axées sur le système en place pour autonomiser les gens. Analyser la demande de soutien pour la solution de mise en oeuvre de la conformité commerciale concernant le système et les données sous notre propriété de processus et effectuer l'amélioration appropriée ou l'élaboration d'initiatives pour fournir une solution efficace et efficiente. Surveiller et analyser la conformité commerciale et agir comme tour de contrôle de la qualité des données sur la conformité commerciale. Effectuer la gérance des données pour les données fournies par nos intervenants (Maisons, Groupe, Région) qui sont sous notre responsabilité et qui sont couvertes par notre Gouvernance des données. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129843 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. “Success in this role comes as much from influence as from analysis. As we transform how we steer our A&P investments — with stronger data, sharper insights, and higher expectations — we are looking for a trusted partner who can engage diverse stakeholders, drive meaningful conversations, and bring forward insights that shape our strategic choices.” WHAT DO WE OFFER At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive. We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences. 
• We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity. "Erfolg in dieser Rolle kommt sowohl vom Einfluss als auch von der Analyse." Bei Cartier wirst du Teil einer Gemeinschaft sein, die durch ein starkes Verantwortungsgefühl gebunden ist, in der Verbindung, Zusammenarbeit und kollektiver Geist gedeihen. Wir befähigen individuelle Talente, vereint durch ein gemeinsames Engagement für Exzellenz, inspiriert von den vielfältigen Kulturen der Welt, unser einzigartiges Erbe zu respektieren und zu bereichern. Wir glauben, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven Innovationen fördern und uns dazu antreiben, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen.

Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertig in Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder Engineering Starke Expertise in der Finanzanalyse, mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in der Budgetierung, Prognose und Berichterstattung über vollständige P & L und Bilanz Solides Verständnis von Management Accounting und IFRS-Standards Starke analytische und Problemlösungskompetenzen, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen zu synthetisieren und in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen Proaktive Denkweise, mit der Fähigkeit, geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu antizipieren und effektive Lösungen vorzuschlagen Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Excel, PowerPoint und SAP BI (oder gleichwertige Berichtstools) Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über Funktionen und Kulturen hinweg zusammenzuarbeiten Hoch organisiert, mit starken Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, Prioritäten effizient zu verwalten Hohe Integrität, Diskretion und Vertraulichkeit fließend in Englisch; Französisch ist ein Plus IHR JOURNEY MIT UNS Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt wird, geben wir Ihnen einen einleitenden Anruf, um weitere Schritte zu erklären und die Gelegenheit zu diskutieren. Wenn es an beiden Enden gut läuft, haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den Hiring Manager und den HR Manager zu treffen. Machen Sie Ihren nächsten Schritt mit Cartier, wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören! jobs.title: Europe FP&A Controller
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129764 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Europe FP&A controller is responsible for financial planning and analysis of the full Europe region for one or two defined Maison(s) of the Group as well as of the wholesale business in Europe for a defined scope of Maisons. This role involves being a key financial partner for Europe Maison Management and Finance teams to support business operations and decision making. Reporting to Europe FP&A Manager, the position is based in Meyrin, Geneva, within our ‘Campus Genevois de Haute Horlogerie’. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Europe Maison FP&A The regional controller is responsible for the consolidation, review and challenge of the local forecasts to ensure alignment with HQ and Maison European management guidelines. Reporting: Consolidation of the Europe markets’ financial statements to report to Maison HQ as well as to Maison European Management. Analytical review of actuals vs forecasts, interact with appropriate stakeholders to understand/correct deviations, and ensure business commentary Planning: Consolidate, analyze and challenge figures to ensure Maison forecasts are in line with the Region / Maison Depending on the Maison, present the Annual budget to the Maison Exco along with the Europe Management Europe Wholesale Financial Planning Coordinate the consolidation of the full P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons Adjust budget figures based on quarterly reviews with the appropriate stakeholders Communicate forecasts and gap analysis to the Maisons HQ Europe Wholesale Monthly Closing & Reporting Activities Perform analytical reviews on the P&L and Cash Flow items for a defined scope of Maisons and report results with comments to Maisons’ HQ Develop and maintain financial reporting to proactively support Maisons’ decision-making processes Support the Management Reporting process (upload and reconcile actual monthly results into the system for consolidation) Run various checks and corrections to ensure accurate closing in line with IFRS Operations Act as a true business partner and strengthen the relationship with Maisons Ensure continuous improvement of business processes to gain efficiency in the organization Support Richemont Europe Management in various ad-hoc requests Participate actively in controlling ad-hoc projects (e.g. system automation, community management, closing process improvements, digitalization, cash-flow guidance, etc.) HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are able to thrive in a complex fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, balance multiple priorities while still contribute thoughtful and high-quality work. You are result oriented with appetite for efficiency through reports automation. You are a strong team player with the ability to communicate and build relationships with various internal partners including Richemont & Maisons Regional Excos. You work well in group problem-solving situations and generate creative solutions. You want to learn quickly with a strong analytic & critical mind-set. You want to evolve in an international and diverse environment, with strong exposure to Top Management. You are capable of being self-motivated and autonomous. Then, you must be the right talent to join our regional team as Europe FP&A Controller. Masters degree in Finance or Business Administration or equivalent 5 years minimum, of confirmed experience in Finance (FP&A, controlling or audit) Experience in Luxury industry a plus Fluent in English, any additional language is a plus You have advanced skills in Excel, you are able to execute analysis in financial and analytical tools (knowledge of SAP and Business Warehouse) Automated and digital skills are a plus WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call with the Talent Acquisition Partner. 2. jobs.title: Head of Retail Excellence
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129783 Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai began as a workshop dedicated to precision instruments, shaped early on by a decisive partnership with the Royal Italian Navy. Designing instruments and tool watches for extreme conditions forged a mindset rooted in performance, innovation, and purpose. After joining the Richemont Group in 1997, Panerai gained international recognition for its distinctive DNA of Italian design and Swiss watchmaking expertise. Today, the Maison continues to create timepieces that push boundaries, translating its technical heritage into contemporary watchmaking for Modern Heroes—individuals driven by curiosity, courage, and the will to go further. We empower those who embrace challenges, value authenticity, and seek to leave a mark, together with a Maison that has never stopped evolving. We are on a mission to elevate our retail performance and cultivate an unyielding culture of excellence across our network. To lead this crucial endeavor, we are seeking a visionary Head of Retail Excellence to join our HQ commercial team. Your mission You will be the driving force behind our retail strategies, translating vision into impactful execution on the ground. Your leadership will ensure unparalleled operational excellence, empower our teams through expertly coordinated training, and cultivate extraordinary client experiences by championing best-in-class VIC management. How will you make an impact? Strategy & Vision: Develop and articulate a comprehensive Retail Excellence strategy aligned with the overall commercial objectives and brand vision. Identify key areas for improvement in retail operations, customer experience, and VIC management. Process Optimization & Standardization: Establish and maintain the Retail Excellence framework and associated procedures, ensuring standards, best practices and consistent execution across all network. Customer Experience Enhancement and focus on our top clients: Champion a customer-centric approach, focusing on elevating the end-to-end customer journey. Implement tools and methodologies to measure and improve customer satisfaction (e.g., NPS, mystery shopping programs). Lead VIC programs, ensuring top-tier client engagement and retention at global level. Collaborate with marketing and product teams to ensure a seamless brand experience. Training & Development: Deliver training programs for retail staff on operational procedures, product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer service excellence. Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the retail teams. Work with HR teams and our training content creator as well as talent teams to ensure talent development and succession planning for key retail roles. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Revenue Growth and commercial performance, CRM & Clienteling, SDP & VM teams as well as HR, IT and supply chain departments to ensure integrated and effective retail strategies. Act as a liaison between corporate functions and retail operations to facilitate communication and alignment. Retail Strategic Initiatives: Lead and manage projects related to retail innovation, new store openings, store renovations, and technology implementations in line with the Richemont Roadmap. Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and expected outcomes. How will you experience success? Bachelor’s or master’s Degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in Retail in the luxury or jewelry/watch industry. Proven experience in developing and implementing retail strategies and best operational practices across multiple locations. Strong understanding of luxury customer expectations and service standards. Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies. Excellent PM skills with a track record of successful execution. Strong ability to lead, motivate, and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are needed with an emphasis on detail and organization, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges. Flexibility to travel. Great hands-on mentality and implementation skills. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages relevant to Richemont's global presence (e.g., French, Italian,…) is a significant advantage. What makes Panerai unique? Join a dynamic Maison spirit that values and empowers your unique skills and contributions. Thrive within enriching communities built on genuine care, continuous improvement, and efficient accountability. Collaborate across borders and cultures, gaining invaluable international experience. Embark on a fulfilling career journey within Panerai and across the Richemont Group. Your journey with us Our recruitment journey is designed to offer insight and enriching exchanges, grounded in transparency, respect and fairness. The recruitment process includes conversations with the Hiring Manager, key business partners, and members of our executive teams. Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR129783 Fondato a Firenze nel 1860, Panerai inizia come laboratorio dedicato agli strumenti di precisione, plasmato all'inizio da una partnership decisiva con la Royal Italian Navy. Strumenti di progettazione e orologi utensili per condizioni estreme hanno forgiato una mentalità radicata nelle prestazioni, nell'innovazione e nello scopo. Dopo essere entrato a far parte del Gruppo Richemont nel 1997, Panerai ha ottenuto il riconoscimento internazionale per il suo DNA distintivo del design italiano e della competenza orologiera svizzera. Oggi la Maison continua a creare orologi che spingono i confini, traducendo il suo patrimonio tecnico in orologiera contemporanea per gli eroi moderni.individui guidati dalla curiosità, dal coraggio e dalla volontà di andare oltre. Noi rafforziamo chi abbraccia sfide, valorizza l'autenticità, e cerchiamo di lasciare un segno, insieme ad una Maison che non ha mai smesso di evolversi. Siamo in missione per il 142 la nostra performance al dettaglio e coltivare una cultura inflessibile di eccellenza attraverso la nostra rete. Per condurre questo cruciale sforzo, stiamo cercando un visionario Head of Retail Excellence per entrare a far parte del nostro team commerciale HQ. La tua missione Sarai la forza trainante delle nostre strategie retail, traducendo la visione in un'esecuzione efficace sul campo. La tua leadership garantirà un'eccellenza operativa senza pari, rafforzerà i nostri team attraverso un addestramento sapientemente coordinato e coltiverà straordinarie esperienze dei clienti, sostenendo la gestione VIC di migliore classe. Strategia & Vision: - Sviluppare e articolare una strategia completa di Retail Excellence allineata agli obiettivi commerciali generali e alla visione del marchio. - Identificare aree chiave per il miglioramento delle operazioni al dettaglio, dell'esperienza del cliente e della gestione VIC. Ottimizzazione e standardizzazione dei processi: - Stabilire e mantenere il quadro di eccellenza al dettaglio e le procedure associate, garantendo standard, migliori pratiche e un'esecuzione coerente su tutta la rete. Customer Experience Enhancement e focus sui nostri clienti più importanti: - Champion un approccio orientato al cliente, focalizzandosi su un percorso di lavoro end-to-end. - Implementa strumenti e metodologie per misurare e migliorare la soddisfazione dei clienti (ad esempio, NPS, programmi di shopping misterioso). - I programmi VIC leader, garantendo un coinvolgimento e una conservazione dei clienti di livello superiore a livello globale. - Collaborate con team di marketing e prodotti per garantire un'esperienza di marca senza soluzione di continuità. Formazione e sviluppo: - Fornire programmi di formazione per il personale al dettaglio su procedure operative, conoscenze dei prodotti, tecniche di vendita e eccellenza del servizio clienti. - Promuovere una cultura di apprendimento e miglioramento continuo all'interno dei team al dettaglio. - Lavorare con i team HR e il nostro creatore di contenuti di formazione e squadre di talenti per garantire lo sviluppo di talenti e la pianificazione di successione per ruoli chiave al dettaglio. Intraprendere iniziative strategiche per il commercio al dettaglio: - guidare e gestire progetti relativi all'innovazione al dettaglio, alle nuove aperture di negozi, alle ristrutturazioni di negozi e alle implementazioni tecnologiche in linea con la tabella di marcia di Richemont. - Sopravvivere alla riuscita dei progetti, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità aziendali e i risultati attesi. Come sperimenterai il successo? - Bachelor.s o master.s Laurea e un minimo di 8 anni di esperienza nel settore del Retail nel settore del lusso o gioielli/watch. - Esperienza di Proven nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie retail e migliori pratiche operative in più sedi. - Forte comprensione delle aspettative dei clienti di lusso e standard di servizio. - Capacità di analizzare i dati, identificare le tendenze e tradurre le informazioni in strategie attuabili. - Ottima capacità di comunicazione e capacità interpersonali con un'enfasi sul dettaglio e sull'organizzazione, con la capacità di gestire più compiti contemporaneamente. - Approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione alle sfide. - Flessibilità di viaggiare. - Grande capacità di gestire la mentalità e l'implementazione. - La fluidità in inglese è necessaria; la competenza in altre lingue rilevanti per la presenza globale di Richemont (ad esempio, francese, italiano,...) è un vantaggio significativo. Cosa rende unico Panerai? - Iscriviti ad uno spirito di Maison dinamico che valorizza e dà forza alle tue competenze e contributi unici. - La sfida all'interno di comunità arricchite da cure genuine, miglioramento continuo e responsabilità efficiente. - Il 21a secolo, attraverso frontiere e culture, guadagnando inestimabili esperienze internazionali. - Embark in un percorso di carriera appagante all'interno di Panerai e attraverso il Gruppo Richemont. Il vostro viaggio con noi Il nostro percorso di reclutamento è pensato per offrire informazioni e scambi arricchenti, fondati sulla trasparenza, sul rispetto e sull'equità. Il processo di reclutamento include conversazioni con il responsabile di noleggio, partner commerciali chiave e membri dei nostri team esecutivi. La vostra prossima avventura inizia a Panerai. Non vediamo l'ora di ascoltare da voi. Referenzcode: JR129783 Panerai wurde 1860 in Florenz gegründet und begann als Workshop für Präzisionsinstrumente, der sich schon früh durch eine entscheidende Partnerschaft mit der Royal Italian Navy auszeichnete. Instrumente und Werkzeuguhren für extreme Bedingungen zu entwerfen, schmiedete eine Denkweise, die in Leistung, Innovation und Zweck begründet war. Nach seinem Beitritt zur Richemont Group im Jahr 1997 erlangte Panerai internationale Anerkennung für seine unverwechselbare DNA des italienischen Designs und der Schweizer Uhrenkompetenz. Heute schafft das Maison immer noch Zeitmesser, die Grenzen überschreiten und sein technisches Erbe in die zeitgenössische Uhrmacherei für moderne Helden übersetzen – Individuen, die von Neugier, Mut und dem Willen angetrieben werden, weiter zu gehen. Wir stärken diejenigen, die Herausforderungen annehmen, Authentizität schätzen und versuchen, eine Marke zu hinterlassen, zusammen mit einem Maison, das sich nie mehr entwickelt hat. Wir sind auf der Mission, unsere Einzelhandelsleistung zu erhöhen und eine unnachgiebige Kultur der Exzellenz in unserem Netzwerk zu pflegen. Um dieses entscheidende Ziel zu erreichen, suchen wir einen visionären Leiter der Retail Excellence, der sich unserem HQ-Geschäftsteam anschließen möchte. Ihre Mission Sie sind die treibende Kraft hinter unseren Retail-Strategien und übersetzen Visionen in eine wirkungsvolle Umsetzung vor Ort. Ihre Führungskraft wird eine beispiellose operative Exzellenz gewährleisten, unsere Teams durch fachgerechtes Training stärken und durch die Entschlossenheit, das beste VIC-Management zu kultivieren, außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrungen sammeln. Strategie & Vision: - Entwicklung und Formulierung einer umfassenden Retail Excellence Strategie, die mit den allgemeinen kommerziellen Zielen und Markenvisionen abgestimmt ist. - Ermittlung wichtiger Bereiche für Verbesserungen im Einzelhandel, Kundenerfahrung und VIC-Management. Prozessoptimierung & Standardisierung: - Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung des Retail Excellence Rahmens und der zugehörigen Verfahren, die Standards, Best Practices und konsequente Umsetzung über alle Netzwerke sicherstellen.
