descriptionByLocale.fr: Reference code: JR129783 Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai began as a workshop dedicated to precision instruments, shaped early on by a decisive partnership with the Royal Italian Navy. Designing instruments and tool watches for extreme conditions forged a mindset rooted in performance, innovation, and purpose. After joining the Richemont Group in 1997, Panerai gained international recognition for its distinctive DNA of Italian design and Swiss watchmaking expertise. Today, the Maison continues to create timepieces that push boundaries, translating its technical heritage into contemporary watchmaking for Modern Heroes—individuals driven by curiosity, courage, and the will to go further. We empower those who embrace challenges, value authenticity, and seek to leave a mark, together with a Maison that has never stopped evolving. We are on a mission to elevate our retail performance and cultivate an unyielding culture of excellence across our network. To lead this crucial endeavor, we are seeking a visionary Head of Retail Excellence to join our HQ commercial team. Your mission You will be the driving force behind our retail strategies, translating vision into impactful execution on the ground. Your leadership will ensure unparalleled operational excellence, empower our teams through expertly coordinated training, and cultivate extraordinary client experiences by championing best-in-class VIC management. How will you make an impact? Strategy & Vision: Develop and articulate a comprehensive Retail Excellence strategy aligned with the overall commercial objectives and brand vision. Identify key areas for improvement in retail operations, customer experience, and VIC management. Process Optimization & Standardization: Establish and maintain the Retail Excellence framework and associated procedures, ensuring standards, best practices and consistent execution across all network. Customer Experience Enhancement and focus on our top clients: Champion a customer-centric approach, focusing on elevating the end-to-end customer journey. Implement tools and methodologies to measure and improve customer satisfaction (e.g., NPS, mystery shopping programs). Lead VIC programs, ensuring top-tier client engagement and retention at global level. Collaborate with marketing and product teams to ensure a seamless brand experience. Training & Development: Deliver training programs for retail staff on operational procedures, product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer service excellence. Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the retail teams. Work with HR teams and our training content creator as well as talent teams to ensure talent development and succession planning for key retail roles. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Revenue Growth and commercial performance, CRM & Clienteling, SDP & VM teams as well as HR, IT and supply chain departments to ensure integrated and effective retail strategies. Act as a liaison between corporate functions and retail operations to facilitate communication and alignment. Retail Strategic Initiatives: Lead and manage projects related to retail innovation, new store openings, store renovations, and technology implementations in line with the Richemont Roadmap. Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and expected outcomes. How will you experience success? Bachelor’s or master’s Degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in Retail in the luxury or jewelry/watch industry. Proven experience in developing and implementing retail strategies and best operational practices across multiple locations. Strong understanding of luxury customer expectations and service standards. Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies. Excellent PM skills with a track record of successful execution. Strong ability to lead, motivate, and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are needed with an emphasis on detail and organization, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges. Flexibility to travel. Great hands-on mentality and implementation skills. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages relevant to Richemont's global presence (e.g., French, Italian,…) is a significant advantage. What makes Panerai unique? Join a dynamic Maison spirit that values and empowers your unique skills and contributions. Thrive within enriching communities built on genuine care, continuous improvement, and efficient accountability. Collaborate across borders and cultures, gaining invaluable international experience. Embark on a fulfilling career journey within Panerai and across the Richemont Group. Your journey with us Our recruitment journey is designed to offer insight and enriching exchanges, grounded in transparency, respect and fairness. The recruitment process includes conversations with the Hiring Manager, key business partners, and members of our executive teams. Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129923 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. QUELLE SERA VOTRE CONTRIBUTION ? En tant que membre de notre équipe R&I Electronic Systems & Solutions (E2S), vous serez le chef d'orchestre de projets complexes et impactants : Pilotage de projets d'innovation : Mener le cadrage, la planification et le suivi de projets R&I stratégiques, depuis la phase d'étude exploratoire jusqu'au transfert de technologie. Définir et gérer les objectifs, les livrables, les plannings et les risques, en vous appuyant sur des méthodologies Agile et Prince2. Coordonner et animer les équipes techniques, les partenaires internes (Manufactures, Maisons) et externes, garantissant une collaboration fluide et efficace. Assurer la rédaction et la formalisation de la documentation projet à chaque étape clé. Expertise technique Firmware & Ultra Low Power : Concevoir et déployer des architectures logicielles embarquées robustes et évolutives, capables de supporter le développement de nos produits. Développer des preuves de concept (POC) et prototypes, avec une approche système intégrée (hardware, software, mécanique). Implémenter et valider des firmwares performants en C, C++ et Python, avec une expertise reconnue sur les microcontrôleurs STM32 et une connaissance des EFR32. Maîtriser l'optimisation de puissance à un niveau micro-ampère et nano-ampère, en gérant finement les modes de veille, l'utilisation du MCU et les périphériques pour atteindre des consommations ultra-faibles. Intégrer et piloter des capteurs complexes via des interfaces comme SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC et des techniques de bitbang. Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de développement rigoureuses, incluant l'utilisation de GIT pour le contrôle de versions, le débogage embarqué et le JTAG. Veille technologique & Innovation : Être force de proposition sur les technologies, concepts et axes de développement innovants qui soutiennent la stratégie R&I du Groupe. Assurer une veille technologique active sur les dernières avancées en systèmes embarqués, microélectronique et gestion de l'énergie. Support à l'industrialisation : Apporter un support technique expert aux Manufactures et Maisons lors du passage en production et garantir la qualité et la robustesse des solutions déployées. QUELLES SONT LES CLÉS DE VOTRE RÉUSSITE ? Ingénieur.e en électronique, systèmes embarqués, microtechnique ou équivalent. Vous justifiez d'une première expérience significative (3 à 5 ans) en développement firmware et en gestion de projets techniques complexes, avec une expertise reconnue en ultra-basse consommation. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise approfondie des langages C et Python. Expertise en architecture logicielle embarquée et capacité à concevoir des solutions évolutives. Connaissance avérée des microcontrôleurs STM32 et une familiarité avec les EFR32. Compétence primordiale en optimisation énergétique pour des applications ultra-low power (cibles nA/µA). Connaissance des interfaces de communication (SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC, bitbang). Pratique de l'intégration de capteurs. Maîtrise des outils de gestion de version comme GIT. Expérience en débogage embarqué et utilisation de JTAG. Expérience en gestion de projet ; connaissance des méthodologies Agile (Scrum, Kanban) et Prince2, un plus. Doté.e d'une forte autonomie, d'un sens aigu de l'organisation et d'excellentes capacités de communication, vous savez fédérer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et résoudre des problèmes complexes avec rigueur et esprit d'analyse. Vous êtes proactif.ve dans l'exploration et l'adoption d'outils innovants, y compris ceux basés sur l'Intelligence Artificielle, pour améliorer l'efficacité du développement. Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit. Le poste est basé principalement à Buttes, au cœur de notre laboratoire d’innovation, avec une présence régulière dans notre hub R&I de Neuchâtel pour favoriser les échanges d’équipe et les synergies. 
• Nous offrons un cadre de travail souple et équilibré grâce à des horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité d’une journée de télétravail par semaine. Il s'agit d'un poste d’une durée de 12 mois, avec possibilité de renouvellement. VOTRE EXPÉRIENCE CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous inviterons pour une entrevue dans nos locaux avec le Responsable du Pôle et le HR Business Partner. Dans un deuxième temps, nous vous soumettrons un cas pratique à réaliser et venir présenter devant un parterre d’experts. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Ingénieur R&I Mécatronique/Electronique Save Buttes, Switzerland Richemont Responsable Développement Montres Save Neuchâtel, Switzerland Panerai Chef de Projet R&I - Qualité Save Neuchâtel, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Data Scientist Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129875 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. We would like to talk to you about the opportunity to join our Maison for an internship as Data Scientist Intern (6 months). As Data Scientist Intern, contribute to the ARIA machine learning project by revamping and enhancing an existing model for short and long-term daily sales prediction. The objective is to update the current outdated model, adapt it to existing data sources, and extend its capabilities to include very short-term (maximum 3 days) predictions for traffic and transactions. Ultimately, this project aims to create an intelligent assistant to help organize boutique operations and provide worldwide forecasts to inform strategic decision-making. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?
• Revamping the existing machine learning model within the ARIA project
• Adapting the chosen model to integrate with current and existing data sources
• Extending the model's predictive scope to include traffic and transaction forecasts REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & PROFILE:
• Engineering School or Master Degree with a specialization in applied mathematics or computer science
• Analytical mindset and structuring skills
• Fluency in English is required; French is a plus WHAT DO WE OFFER
• We create a positive environment and highlight your personal and team performances.
• We’re fully transparent and share with you: Maison strategies, key information, needs of others Corporate Departments.
• We constantly educate you with: Cartier’s savoir-faire, competitive landscape, industry news, client experience best practices. Similar Jobs INTL. We would like to talk to you about the opportunity to join our Maison for an internship as Data Scientist Intern (6 months). As Data Scientist Intern, contribute to the ARIA machine learning project by revamping and enhancing an existing model for short and long-term daily sales prediction. The objective is to update the current outdated model, adapt it to existing data sources, and extend its capabilities to include very short-term (maximum 3 days) predictions for traffic and transactions. Ultimately, this project aims to create an intelligent assistant to help organize boutique operations and provide worldwide forecasts to inform strategic decision-making. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

jobs.description: Reference code: JR129978 Supply Chain & Operations Data Intern Plan-les-Ouates 12-month internship FOR THOSE WHO WELCOME CONNECTION Join a highly connected community where individual expertise and shared experience combine across disciplines to spark fresh ideas and keep us moving forwards. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE We are looking for a Supply Chain and Operations / Manufacturing Data Intern to join us for a 12-month critical mission. This role involves maintaining and enhancing reporting systems and analytics to provide necessary business insights as part of a business data transformation. You will collect, analyse and validate complex Supply Chain and Manufacturing data from various sources while ensuring robust data visualisation tools. This role requires a keen eye for detail, strong analytical capabilities and the ability to foster cross-functional collaboration with multiple stakeholders. PLAYING YOUR PART Advanced Data Analysis & Reporting: Support and enhance Power BI / Looker dashboards, transforming complex data into actionable insights Manage data to identify trends, anomalies, and risks through multiple Operational metrics Stakeholder Collaboration & Strategic Impact: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their analytical needs Manage expectations, deliver quality solutions on time, and contribute to the analytical roadmap, aligned with strategic objectives Data Quality & Governance: Maintain rigorous standards for data accuracy and integrity Implement data validation, document reporting logic and adhere to internal policies Process Optimisation & Continuous Improvement: Identify inefficiencies and suggesting improvement opportunities in processes through data analysis Develop strategies to visually optimize operations, reduce costs and enhance efficiency, fostering continuous improvement Data Storytelling & Communication: Effectively communicate complex insights to diverse audiences through visualizations and clear narratives Enable stakeholders to make informed, data-driven decisions WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require: Master’s degree in Data, Engineering, Business Intelligence, or equivalent experience Good understanding of reporting & analytics processes; Supply Chain, Manufacturing or Operations focussed Proficiency in advanced analytics tools (e.g., Power Bi, Looker, SQL, Data modelling, BigQuery, knowledge of SAP or other ERP system,); strong hands-on Power BI and or Looker delivery Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights; positive attitude and growth mindset with a strong sense of ownership and keen eye for detail Excellent communication skills in English and French. Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence : JR129978 Supply Chain & Operations Data Internaute Plan-les-Ouates Stage de 12 mois POUR LES BIENVENUES Rejoignez une communauté très connectée où l'expertise individuelle et l'expérience partagée se combinent entre disciplines pour susciter de nouvelles idées et nous faire avancer. Jouez votre rôle dans la conduite de notre succès collectif. Votre rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Supply Chain and Operations / Manufacturing Data Internaute pour nous rejoindre pour une mission critique de 12 mois. Ce rôle consiste à maintenir et à améliorer les systèmes d'établissement de rapports et d'analyse afin de fournir les renseignements opérationnels nécessaires dans le cadre d'une transformation des données opérationnelles. Ce rôle exige un regard attentif sur les détails, de solides capacités d'analyse et la capacité de favoriser la collaboration interfonctionnelle avec plusieurs intervenants. METTRE EN PLACE VOTRE PARTIE Analyse avancée des données et rapports : Soutenir et améliorer les tableaux de bord Power BI / Looker, transformer les données complexes en données concrètes Gérer les données pour identifier les tendances, les anomalies et les risques grâce à de multiples mesures opérationnelles Collaboration des intervenants et impact stratégique : Collaborer avec les intervenants pour comprendre leurs besoins analytiques Gérer les attentes, fournir des solutions de qualité à temps et contribuer à la feuille de route analytique, alignée sur les objectifs stratégiques Qualité et gouvernance des données : Maintenir des normes rigoureuses en matière d'exactitude et d'intégrité des données Mettre en oeuvre la validation des données, documenter la logique des rapports et adhérer aux politiques internes Optimisation des processus et amélioration continue : Identifier les possibilités d'amélioration des processus grâce à l'analyse des données Élaborer des stratégies pour optimiser visuellement les opérations, réduire les coûts et améliorer l'efficacité, favoriser l'amélioration continue Récapitulation et communication des données : communiquer efficacement les données complexes à divers publics grâce à des visualisations et à des récits clairs Permettre aux intervenants de prendre des décisions éclairées et axées sur les données QUOI VOUS SUCCESSEFUL? La réussite de ce rôle exigera : une maîtrise en données, en génie, en intelligence des affaires ou expérience équivalente Une bonne compréhension des processus de rapport et d'analyse; une connaissance approfondie de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la fabrication ou des opérations dans les outils d'analyse avancés (p. ex., Power Bi, Looker, SQL, Data modeling, BigQuery, connaissance de SAP ou d'un autre système ERP); une solide capacité pratique de Power BI et ou de Looker une bonne capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire les données en idées concrètes; une attitude positive et un état d'esprit de croissance avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation et un regard vif pour les détails. Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans comme le plus ancien horloger du monde en production continue depuis 1755. Basé à Genève, en Suisse, nous exploitons un réseau mondial de détail de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté mondiale exceptionnelle d'horlogers, d'artisans et de professionnels dévoués partagent une dévotion commune à notre patrimoine exceptionnel et une passion pour faire briller un avenir encore plus brillant. jobs.title: New Foundations Programme Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130029 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation. As Programme Manager for New Foundations, you will own the day-to-day orchestration, cadence and operational discipline of this strategic transformation programme. You will ensure the programme runs as a single, integrated effort, with decisions, risks and dependencies tracked and executed consistently across all workstreams. Partnering closely with the Programme Director, the programme team and wider Group Platforms stakeholders, you will be the trusted operational backbone of the programme, with no content ownership. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will: Co-design the New Foundations programme with the Programme Director and wider Group Platforms stakeholders, translating ambition, governance and decisions into a structured and executable plan. Orchestrate overall programme execution, ensuring all streams progress in line with agreed scope, cadence and priorities. Maintain a single integrated view of the programme and own its cadence and rhythm — planning cycles, forums, milestones and decision tracking. Prepare and drive arbitration processes with relevant stakeholders, framing options, impacts and trade-offs for the Programme Director and Group Platforms Executive Committee (ExCo). Track decisions and non-negotiables, ensuring commitments are clearly recorded and reflected in plans and deliverables, following up on actions, managing slippage and escalating risks early. Coordinate documentation and readiness for Discovery deliverables and the planning and preparation of Solution Design. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Strong background in programme orchestration and complex delivery environments. Experience operating in multi-entity, Group-level programmes Exposure to large-scale ERP transformations, ideally including SAP S/4HANA conversions. Experience working with external consulting partners during initial programme set-up. Programme structuring and planning, including cadence, milestones and dependency management. Rigorous tracking and follow-through, turning decisions into executable actions. Risk and issue management, with early identification and escalation. Clear synthesis and framing, consolidating complex inputs into concise programme views. Strong coordination across business, technology, finance and change management teams. Highly disciplined, structured and execution-oriented. Comfortable operating in complex environment Focused on outcomes, follow-through and operational excellence. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Our recruitment journey for this role is designed to be respectful, transparent and grounded in genuine dialogue. You can typically expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations and the role. A meeting with Hiring Manager and HR for this role. A final conversation focused on mutual fit, expectations and next steps. We are committed to providing timely, transparent feedback at each stage of the process. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Scope & Simplification Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Product Manager - Customer Relations Centers (CRCs) Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130029 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. TUA MISSIONE: Nuove Fondazioni è il programma di trasformazione pluriennale di Richemont per semplificare e allineare i processi aziendali e la tecnologia in preparazione alla migrazione del Gruppo a SAP S/4HANA. È progettato per creare le basi organizzative, di governance e di consegna necessarie per consentire una trasformazione ERP di successo, scalabile e gestita dal business. In qualità di Direttore del Programma per le Nuove Fondazioni, possederai l'orchestrazione quotidiana, la cadenza e la disciplina operativa di questo programma di trasformazione strategica. Si assicurerà che il programma funzioni come uno sforzo unico e integrato, con decisioni, rischi e dipendenze tracciate e eseguite in modo coerente su tutti i flussi di lavoro. Collaborando a stretto contatto con il Direttore del Programma, il team di programma e gli stakeholder di Piattaforme di Gruppo più ampi, sarete la spina dorsale operativa di fiducia del programma, senza alcuna proprietà dei contenuti. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In questo ruolo, Lei sarà: Co-design il programma delle Nuove Fondazioni con il Direttore del Programma e le più ampie Piattaforme del Gruppo stakeholders, traducendo ambizione, governance e decisioni in un piano strutturato ed eseguibile. Orchestrate l'esecuzione complessiva del programma, assicurando tutti i flussi di progresso in linea con la portata concordata, la cadenza e le priorità. Mantenere una visione integrata del programma e possedere la sua cadenza e ritmo — cicli di pianificazione, forum, pietre miliari e monitoraggio delle decisioni. Preparare e guidare processi di arbitrato con le parti interessate pertinenti, opzioni di inquadramento, impatti e trade-off per il Direttore del programma e Comitato Esecutivo Piattaforme di gruppo (ExCo). Traccia le decisioni e i non negoziabili, assicurando che gli impegni siano chiaramente registrati e riflessi in piani e consegnabili, seguendo le azioni, gestendo i rischi di slittamento e di escalation in anticipo. Coordinate la documentazione e la disponibilità per i prodotti Discovery e la pianificazione e la preparazione di Solution Design. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Forte sfondo nell'orchestrazione di programmi e ambienti di consegna complessi. Esperienza operativa in multi-entity, programmi a livello di Gruppo Esposizione a trasformazioni ERP su larga scala, idealmente comprese le conversioni SAP S/4HANA. Esperienza di collaborazione con partner di consulenza esterni durante l'avvio del programma. Strutturazione e pianificazione del programma, tra cui cadenza, pietre miliari e gestione della dipendenza. Rigoroso monitoraggio e follow-through, trasformando le decisioni in azioni eseguibili. Rischio e gestione dei problemi, con identificazione precoce e escalation. Chiaro sintesi e inquadramento, consolidando ingressi complessi le opinioni dei programmi concisi. Forte coordinamento tra business, tecnologia, finanza e team di gestione dei cambiamenti. Altamente disciplinato, strutturato e orientato all'esecuzione. Confortevole funzionamento in ambiente complesso Focused sui risultati, il follow-through e l'eccellenza operativa. Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. Adottiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità. Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. Il nostro viaggio di reclutamento per questo ruolo è pensato per essere rispettoso, trasparente e fondato in un dialogo autentico. In genere ci si può aspettare: una conversazione iniziale con il nostro team Talent Acquisition per discutere il tuo background, le motivazioni e il ruolo. Un incontro con Hiring Manager e HR per questo ruolo. Una conversazione finale focalizzata sulla mutua vestibilità, le aspettative e i prossimi passi. Ci impegniamo a fornire feedback tempestivi e trasparenti in ogni fase del processo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Scope & Simplification Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Data Project Management Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

Es wurde entwickelt, um die Organisations-, Governance- und Liefergrundlagen zu schaffen, die für eine erfolgreiche, skalierbare und unternehmensgeführte ERP-Transformation erforderlich sind. Hoch diszipliniert, strukturiert und umsetzungsorientiert. Komfortables Arbeiten in komplexer Umgebung Fokussiert auf Ergebnisse, Folgemaßnahmen und operative Exzellenz. Unsere wahre Kraft liegt nicht in unseren Ähnlichkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer spezifischen Fähigkeit, ungenutzte Potenziale zu fördern. VOTRE MISSION : Les nouvelles fondations sont le programme de transformation pluriannuel de Richemont pour simplifier et aligner les processus et la technologie en préparation de la migration du Groupe vers SAP S/4HANA. Il est conçu pour créer les fondations organisationnelles, de gouvernance et de prestation nécessaires pour permettre une transformation réussie, évolutive et dirigée par les entreprises. En tant que responsable de programme pour les nouvelles fondations, vous serez propriétaire de l'orchestration quotidienne, de la cadence et de la discipline opérationnelle de ce programme de transformation stratégique. Vous vous assurerez que le programme fonctionne comme un effort unique et intégré, avec des décisions, des risques et des dépendances suivis et exécutés de façon cohérente dans tous les secteurs de travail. En étroite collaboration avec le directeur du programme, l'équipe du programme et les parties prenantes des plates-formes de groupe, vous serez l'épine dorsale opérationnelle de confiance du programme, sans prise en charge du contenu. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Dans ce rôle, vous allez : Co-concevoir le programme des nouvelles fondations avec le directeur de programme et les parties prenantes plus larges des plateformes de groupe, transformant l'ambition, la gouvernance et les décisions en un plan structuré et exécutable. Ordonner l'exécution globale du programme, en veillant à ce que tous les flux progressent conformément à la portée, à la cadence et aux priorités convenues. Maintenir une vision unique et intégrée du programme et posséder sa cadence et son rythme - cycles de planification, forums, jalons et suivi des décisions. Préparer et diriger les processus d'arbitrage avec les parties prenantes concernées, définir les options, les impacts et les compromis pour le Comité exécutif des plates-formes de programme et de groupe (ExCo). Suivre les décisions et les non-négociables, s'assurer que les engagements sont clairement consignés et reflétés dans les plans et les produits livrables, assurer le suivi des mesures, gérer les retards et accroître les risques rapidement. Coordonner la documentation et l'état de préparation des produits livrables de Découverte ainsi que la planification et la préparation de la conception de solutions. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre ? Un contexte solide dans l'orchestration des programmes et des environnements d'exécution complexes. Expérience dans les programmes multi-entités au niveau du groupe Exposition aux transformations ERP à grande échelle, y compris idéalement les conversions SAP S/4HANA. Expérience de travail avec des partenaires de consultation externes lors de la mise en place initiale du programme. structuration et planification des programmes, y compris la cadence, les étapes et la gestion de la dépendance. Suivi et suivi rigoureux, transformant les décisions en actions exécutables. Gestion des risques et des enjeux, avec identification précoce et escalade. Une synthèse et un cadrage clairs, regroupant des apports complexes dans des vues concises sur les programmes. Une solide coordination entre les équipes de gestion des affaires, de la technologie, des finances et du changement. Très discipliné, structuré et orienté vers l'exécution. Fonctionnement confortable dans un environnement complexe Concentré sur les résultats, le suivi et l'excellence opérationnelle. Qu'est-ce qui fait que notre groupe est différent ? Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similarités, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à favoriser un potentiel inexploité. Nous apprécions la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. Nous favorisons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE JOURNÉE AVEC NOUS Notre parcours de recrutement pour ce rôle est conçu pour être respectueux, transparent et ancré dans un véritable dialogue. Vous pouvez généralement vous attendre: Une première conversation avec notre équipe d'acquisition de talents pour discuter de vos antécédents, motivations et le rôle. Réunion avec le gestionnaire de l'embauche et les RH pour ce rôle. Une dernière conversation a porté sur l'ajustement mutuel, les attentes et les prochaines étapes. Nous nous engageons à fournir des commentaires en temps opportun et transparent à chaque étape du processus. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Emplois similaires Nouvelles fondations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Suisse Richemont Nouvelles fondations Scope & Simplification Manager Save Meyrin, Suisse Richemont Data Project Management Intern Save Meyrin, Suisse Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR130031 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation. As Technical Manager for New Foundations, you will own the target technology architecture and shape the technology evolution path required to deliver Richemont’s SAP S/4HANA migration. You will ensure that the adoption decisions made through scope and simplification translate into a coherent, future-proof and sustainable enterprise landscape, extending well beyond the conversion event itself. Working under the Programme Director, you will collaborate with technology experts to define the migration roadmap with Group Platforms and guide the evolution of the ERP landscape across the programme lifecycle. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will: Own the target-state technology architecture and define the future SAP S/4HANA-centred landscape — ERP core, satellites, integrations and extensions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and third-party platforms. Translate scope and simplification decisions into a viable and scalable architecture blueprint, aligned with Group architecture principles and clean-core strategy. Define clear ERP boundaries, ensuring consistency between what is removed or simplified and what is rebuilt, extended or externalised. Own the integration and extensibility strategy, including application programming interfaces (APIs), middleware and event-driven patterns. Assess technical feasibility, dependencies and sequencing, anchoring ambition in technical reality. Prepare technology principles, architecture guardrails and the inputs required for Solution Design. Partner with product and technical teams to upskill on SAP S/4HANA and ensure decisions are grounded in technical reality. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Senior experience in large-scale ERP and platform transformations (SAP S/4HANA is a must). Proven track record in Technical Architecture in complex environments. Deep experience designing hybrid landscapes (ERP, satellites, data, integrations, cloud platforms). Comfortable engaging with senior technology and business leaders, including ExCo-level forums. Experience operating in an international multi-entity or multi-brand environments. Strong mastery of SAP S/4HANA architecture patterns, clean-core principles and extensibility models. Deep understanding of integration architectures, APIs, middleware and SAP BTP. Ability to translate simplification and legacy constraints into forward-looking architecture choices. Strong analytical capability to frame technology trade-offs (standard vs flexibility vs cost). Structured decision framing, with a focus on long-term operability and scalability. Strong long-term and systems thinking. Comfortable holding the line on architectural non-negotiables. Credible authority with both technology and business stakeholders. Acts as a steward of future value, not a defender of current solutions. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Our recruitment journey for this role is designed to be respectful, transparent and grounded in genuine dialogue. You can typically expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations and the role. A meeting with Hiring Manager for this role. Subsequent interviews with key Group Platforms stakeholders and members of the New Foundations programme team to explore your experience in depth. A final conversation focused on mutual fit, expectations and next steps. We are committed to providing timely, transparent feedback at each stage of the process. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs New Foundations Scope & Simplification Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Programme Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Logistics Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR130028 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will work in collaboration with the Clienteling Senior Product Owner (PO) to collect the Maison requirements, define the clienteling product roadmap, and support continuous enhancements and innovation: In line with this, your key responsibilities would include: Collects, consolidates, and analyzes the Maisons’ requests for clienteling product evolutions. Supports the preparation of the prioritization ceremonies with the Maisons and technical teams, to define, in collaboration with Senior PO, the product evolution roadmap. Supports the Senior PO, UX/UI team, and Technical team to design and monitor the development of changes and new features. Ensures proper feature delivery compared to business requirements. Monitors and supports the resolution of bugs identified by the Maisons. Collaborates with the Change and Adoption team to foster end-user adoption, by maintaining up-to-date and easy-to-use documentation for end-users. Proposes complementary initiatives and best practices to ensure consistency and end-user satisfaction when developing new features (e.g., translation, naming, flows). HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You have a first experience in client relationship and engagement topics (CRM, Clienteling, Client Activation, etc.) or in retail. Ideally, you have prior experience in product management (ideally as PO or Proxy PO). You are agile, flexible and have a team spirit. You have good organizational and project coordination skills. You are fluent in English, French is a plus. You have a sensitivity for luxury and retail sectors. You are at ease with Microsoft Suite, Salesforce (service cloud), and project planning and ticketing platforms (JIRA, Monday, Confluence, etc.) An internship agreement with your school/university is mandatory. Available for a 6-month internship with a starting date of July 15, 2026. This is a great opportunity to truly gain great insight into the luxury markets. You will be a part of a dynamic and international work environment, where we always go the extra mile to uphold outstanding service for our clients. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Internal Warehouse (Senior) Product Owner Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Test Management Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Strategic Projects Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130028 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Come fai a fare un'infezione? lavorerai in collaborazione con il Clienteling Senior Product Owner (PO) per raccogliere i requisiti della Maison, definire la roadmap del prodotto della clientela e supportare miglioramenti continui e innovazione: In linea con questo, le vostre responsabilità chiave includono: Raccogliere, consolidare e analizzare le richieste delle Maison per la clientela delle evoluzioni dei prodotti. Supporta la preparazione delle cerimonie di priorità con le Maison e i team tecnici, per definire, in collaborazione con Senior PO, la roadmap di evoluzione del prodotto. Supporta il team senior PO, UX/UI e il team tecnico per progettare e monitorare lo sviluppo di modifiche e nuove funzionalità. Garantisce una corretta consegna delle caratteristiche rispetto ai requisiti aziendali. Monitora e supporta la risoluzione di bug identificati dalle Maison. Collabora con il team Change and Adoption per promuovere l'adozione degli utenti finali, mantenendo la documentazione aggiornata e facile da usare per gli utenti finali. Propone iniziative complementari e buone pratiche per garantire coerenza e soddisfazione dell'utente finale nello sviluppo di nuove funzionalità (ad esempio, traduzione, denominazione, flussi). Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Hai una prima esperienza nel rapporto cliente e argomenti di impegno (CRM, Clienteling, Attivazione client, ecc.) o nel retail. Idealmente, avete esperienza precedente nella gestione del prodotto (idealmente come PO o Proxy PO). Sei agile, flessibile e hai uno spirito di squadra. Hai buone capacità di coordinamento organizzativo e progettuale. Sei fluente in inglese, il francese è un vantaggio. Hai una sensibilità per i settori del lusso e del retail. Sei a tuo agio con Microsoft Suite, Salesforce (service cloud), e piattaforme di pianificazione e ticketing del progetto (JIRA, Lunedi, Confluenza, ecc.) Un accordo di stage con la tua scuola/università è obbligatorio. Disponibile per uno stage di 6 mesi con una data di partenza del 15 luglio 2026. Questa è una grande opportunità per acquisire veramente grande comprensione nei mercati di lusso. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130030 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation. As Scope and Simplification Manager for New Foundations, you will drive business process transformation and configuration simplification across the programme, ensuring scope decisions are grounded in business impact, value and transformation readiness. Working in close partnership with the organisation and reporting to Programme Director, you will leverage your SAP S/4HANA expertise to bridge the gap between Richemont’s current operations and its future-state processes, functionalities and configuration — acting as the guardian of simplicity, harmonisation and clean-core discipline. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will: Own the assessment of current business processes and configuration against SAP S/4HANA standards, identifying transformation opportunities, business impacts and change efforts. Orchestrate the work of Business Process Managers (BPMs) and functional teams to map, challenge and optimise end-to-end processes, ensuring process ownership stays with the business. Lead simplification initiatives across processes and custom code, looking to standardise, harmonise or carry forward based on business value and operational impact. Frame keep / adapt / retire decisions through a business-value lens to right-size the ERP. Assess the business impact of scope decisions, ensuring the organisation understands the changes, operational consequences and transformation readiness. Work to upskill the organization on SAP S/4HANA processes and standard functionalities, building functional fluency across business teams. Work closely with the ECC Functional Expert to anchor recommendations in the reality of the current landscape, surfacing constraints, risks and dependencies. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Experience with SAP S/4HANA programmes and transformations. Proven track record in process simplification or standardisation in complex environments. Strong exposure to end-to-end business processes (for example Finance, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash). Comfortable engaging with senior business and Senior Technology leaders. Experience operating in Group, multi-entity or multi-brand environments. Skilled at translating business requirements into standard, scalable SAP S/4HANA outcomes. Deep understanding of SAP S/4HANA standard processes, clean-core principles and, where possible, the ECC landscape. Solid process modelling and documentation capability and experience. Analytical rigour to frame keep / adapt / retire decisions with clear trade-offs. Ability to distil complexity into actionable scope and simplification options. Effective stakeholder communication across senior business and technology audiences. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Our recruitment journey for this role is designed to be respectful, transparent and grounded in genuine dialogue. You can typically expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations and the role. A meeting with Hiring Manager and HR for this role. Subsequent interviews with key Group Platforms stakeholders and members of the New Foundations programme team to explore your experience in depth. A final conversation focused on mutual fit, expectations and next steps. We are committed to providing timely, transparent feedback at each stage of the process. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Programme Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Business Analyst Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130030 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. TUA MISSIONE: Nuove Fondazioni è il programma di trasformazione pluriennale di Richemont per semplificare e allineare i processi aziendali e la tecnologia in preparazione alla migrazione del Gruppo a SAP S/4HANA. È progettato per creare le basi organizzative, di governance e di consegna necessarie per consentire una trasformazione ERP di successo, scalabile e gestita dal business. In qualità di Scope and Simplification Manager for New Foundations, guiderai la trasformazione del processo di business e la semplificazione della configurazione in tutto il programma, assicurando che le decisioni di portata siano fondate sull'impatto aziendale, sul valore e sulla prontezza della trasformazione. Lavorando in stretta collaborazione con l’organizzazione e segnalando al Direttore del Programma, leverai le tue competenze SAP S/4HANA per colmare il divario tra le operazioni attuali di Richemont e i suoi processi, le funzionalità e la configurazione futuri dello stato, fungendo da custode della semplicità, dell’armonizzazione e della disciplina di base pulita. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In questo ruolo, Lei sarà: Possa la valutazione dei processi aziendali attuali e la configurazione contro gli standard SAP S/4HANA, identificando le opportunità di trasformazione, gli impatti aziendali e gli sforzi di cambiamento. Organizza il lavoro di Business Process Managers (BPMs) e team funzionali per mappare, sfidare e ottimizzare i processi end-to-end, assicurando la gestione dei processi con il business. Condurre iniziative di semplificazione attraverso processi e codice personalizzato, cercando di standardizzare, armonizzare o portare avanti in base al valore aziendale e all'impatto operativo. Tenere / adattare / retirare le decisioni attraverso una lente di valore aziendale per dimensionare a destra l'ERP. Valuta l'impatto commerciale delle decisioni di portata, assicurando che l'organizzazione comprenda i cambiamenti, le conseguenze operative e la prontezza di trasformazione. Lavorare per upskill l'organizzazione su processi SAP S/4HANA e funzionalità standard, costruendo fluidità funzionale tra i team aziendali. Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'ECC Functional Expert per ancorare raccomandazioni nella realtà del paesaggio attuale, vincoli di surf, rischi e dipendenze. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Esperienza con programmi e trasformazioni SAP S/4HANA. Provato record di traccia nella semplificazione del processo o standardizzazione in ambienti complessi. Forte esposizione ai processi aziendali end-to-end (ad esempio Finance, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash). Confortevole coinvolgimento con senior business e Senior Technology leader. Esperienza operativa in ambienti di Gruppo, multi-entity o multi-brand. Abilitato nel tradurre i requisiti aziendali in risultati SAP S/4HANA standard e scalabili. Profonda comprensione dei processi standard SAP S/4HANA, dei principi essenziali e, se possibile, del paesaggio ECC. Solido processo di modellazione e capacità di documentazione ed esperienza. rigore analitico per inquadrare tenere / adattare / ritirare le decisioni con i compromessi chiari. Capacità di distilare la complessità nelle opzioni di portata e semplificazione attuabili. Efficace comunicazione degli stakeholder attraverso il pubblico senior di business e tecnologia. Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. Adottiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità. Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. Il nostro viaggio di reclutamento per questo ruolo è pensato per essere rispettoso, trasparente e fondato in un dialogo autentico. In genere ci si può aspettare: una conversazione iniziale con il nostro team Talent Acquisition per discutere il tuo background, le motivazioni e il ruolo. Un incontro con Hiring Manager e HR per questo ruolo. Successive interviste ai principali stakeholder delle Piattaforme di Gruppo e ai membri del team di programma delle Nuove Fondazioni per esplorare la vostra esperienza in profondità. Una conversazione finale focalizzata sulla mutua vestibilità, le aspettative e i prossimi passi. Ci impegniamo a fornire feedback tempestivi e trasparenti in ogni fase del processo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont New Foundations Programme Manager Save Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont Upstream Approvvigionamento Product Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont

Als Scope and Simplification Manager für neue Stiftungen treiben Sie die Transformation von Geschäftsprozessen und die Konfigurationsvereinfachung im gesamten Programm voran und stellen sicher, dass Umfangsentscheidungen auf Geschäftswirkung, Wert und Transformationsbereitschaft beruhen. In enger Partnerschaft mit der Organisation und der Berichterstattung an den Programmdirektor nutzen Sie Ihre SAP S/4HANA-Expertise, um die Lücke zwischen den aktuellen Operationen von Richemont und seinen zukünftigen Prozessen, Funktionalitäten und Konfigurationen zu schließen – als Hüter der Einfachheit, Harmonisierung und sauberen Kerndisziplin. Ein Treffen mit Hiring Manager und HR für diese Rolle. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR130030 Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux biens de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. VOTRE MISSION : Les nouvelles fondations sont le programme de transformation pluriannuel de Richemont pour simplifier et aligner les processus et la technologie en préparation de la migration du Groupe vers SAP S/4HANA. Il est conçu pour créer les fondations organisationnelles, de gouvernance et de prestation nécessaires pour permettre une transformation réussie, évolutive et dirigée par les entreprises. En tant que gestionnaire de la portée et de la simplification pour les nouvelles fondations, vous dirigerez la transformation des processus d'affaires et la simplification de la configuration dans l'ensemble du programme, en veillant à ce que les décisions de portée soient fondées sur l'impact, la valeur et la préparation à la transformation. En étroite collaboration avec l'organisation et en faisant rapport au directeur de programme, vous tirerez parti de votre expertise SAP S/4HANA pour combler l'écart entre les opérations actuelles de Richemont et ses processus, fonctionnalités et configurations d'état futur, en tant que gardien de la simplicité, de l'harmonisation et de la discipline de base. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Dans ce rôle, vous : Possédez l'évaluation des processus opérationnels actuels et de la configuration par rapport aux normes SAP S/4HANA, en identifiant les possibilités de transformation, les impacts commerciaux et les efforts de changement. Ordonner le travail des gestionnaires de processus opérationnels (BPM) et des équipes fonctionnelles pour cartographier, défier et optimiser les processus de bout en bout, en veillant à ce que la propriété des processus reste avec l'entreprise. Diriger les initiatives de simplification à travers les processus et les codes personnalisés, en cherchant à normaliser, harmoniser ou poursuivre en fonction de la valeur opérationnelle et de l'impact opérationnel. Le cadre conserve / adapte / retire les décisions à travers une lentille de valeur commerciale pour la taille droite de l'ERP. Évaluer l'impact opérationnel des décisions de portée, en veillant à ce que l'organisation comprenne les changements, les conséquences opérationnelles et la capacité de transformation. Travailler à améliorer l'organisation sur les processus SAP S/4HANA et les fonctionnalités standard, en renforçant la fluidité fonctionnelle entre les équipes d'affaires. Collaborer étroitement avec l'Expert fonctionnel du CCE pour ancrer les recommandations dans la réalité du paysage actuel, surmonter les contraintes, les risques et les dépendances. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre ? Expérience des programmes et transformations SAP S/4HANA. Expérience éprouvée en matière de simplification des processus ou de normalisation dans des environnements complexes. Une forte exposition aux processus opérationnels de bout en bout (par exemple Finances, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash). Engagement confortable avec les chefs d'entreprise et de technologie senior. Expérience dans les environnements de groupe, multi-entité ou multi-marques. Compétence pour traduire les exigences opérationnelles en résultats standard et évolutifs SAP S/4HANA. Compréhension approfondie des processus standard SAP S/4HANA, des principes de base propres et, si possible, du paysage CEC. Capacité et expérience solides de modélisation des processus et de documentation. La rigueur analytique pour encadrer les décisions de garder / adapter / prendre sa retraite avec des compromis clairs. Capacité à distiller la complexité en options de portée et de simplification réalisables. Une communication efficace des intervenants à l'échelle des principaux groupes d'entreprises et de technologie. Qu'est-ce qui fait que notre groupe est différent ? Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similarités, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à favoriser un potentiel inexploité. Nous apprécions la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. Nous favorisons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE JOURNÉE AVEC NOUS Notre parcours de recrutement pour ce rôle est conçu pour être respectueux, transparent et ancré dans un véritable dialogue. Vous pouvez généralement vous attendre: Une première conversation avec notre équipe d'acquisition de talents pour discuter de vos antécédents, motivations et le rôle. Réunion avec le gestionnaire de l'embauche et les RH pour ce rôle. Par la suite, des entretiens ont eu lieu avec les principaux intervenants du Groupe Platforms et des membres de l'équipe du programme Nouvelles fondations pour explorer en profondeur votre expérience. Une dernière conversation a porté sur l'ajustement mutuel, les attentes et les prochaines étapes. Nous nous engageons à fournir des commentaires en temps opportun et transparent à chaque étape du processus. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Emplois similaires Nouvelles fondations - S4HANA Transformation Tech Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Program Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Achat en amont Product Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

After joining the Richemont Group in 1997, Panerai gained international recognition for its distinctive DNA of Italian design and Swiss watchmaking expertise. Today, the Maison continues to create timepieces that push boundaries, translating its technical heritage into contemporary watchmaking for Modern Heroes—individuals driven by curiosity, courage, and the will to go further. We empower those who embrace challenges, value authenticity, and seek to leave a mark, together with a Maison that has never stopped evolving. Afin de renforcer notre Bureau Technique, au sein de notre département R&D, nous recrutons actuellement un : Constructeur·rice Habillage
• Votre mission
• Votre mission sera de développer des solutions techniques fiables et innovantes pour nos produits, en assurant leur faisabilité, leur qualité et leur mise au point jusqu’à l’industrialisation. Comment allez-vous faire la différence ? Phase de développement nouveaux produits Elaborer au besoin les phases de pré-études afin de garantir la faisabilité du projet, Participer à l’analyse de risques Réaliser les 3D’s et mises en plans sous CREO des nouveaux produits dans le but de fournir un dossier technique complet et viable, Réaliser les nomenclatures articles de définition tout en étant garant de la qualité des données, Veiller aux coûts/qualité/délais de la réalisation des dossiers techniques en tenant compte des exigences du brief Design, des données marketing, de l’industrialisation, du SAV, des méthodologies ainsi que les standards de conception en vigueur, Présenter les projets aux revues BTH ainsi qu’aux revue de construction avec les départements concernés avant la réalisation des prototypes, Respecter les différentes livrables des jalons métier en fonction du projet; anticiper et alerter les dérives, Régler les problèmes techniques qui peuvent survenir lors de l’industrialisation et adapter les données existantes, Assurer le contrôle et le support technique tout au long du développement ainsi que de la mise au point des produits en collaborant avec l’interne et les fournisseurs, Réaliser les Demandes De Modifications (esthétiques, techniques, marketing,…) via Windchill. Projets transverses ou études de nouveaux concepts Suivre les évolutions techniques des produits horlogers habillage; assurer une veille technologique, Développer des concepts produits innovants et présenter les solutions techniques aux différentes équipes/départements impactés, Dans le cadre de la vie série, améliorer les principes techniques existants. Quelles sont les clés de votre réussite au sein de notre maison ? Maitrise du logiciel CAO CREO (Méthodologie SENS et CREO Simulate un plus et connaissances de l’outil WindChill, Cotation ISO GPS, Fort attrait pour la technique, l’innovation et la créativité, Esprit d’équipe et sens de la communication, Rigueur, méthode, capacité d'analyse et de synthèse, Ouverture au changement, agilité et autonomie, Connaissance des produits, un plus, Connaissances sur la propriété intellectuelle et le cycle de vie d’un brevet, un plus. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130111 Since MONTBLANC revolutionized writing culture in 1906 with the first spill-proof fountain pen, we have been known for outstanding craftsmanship, highest aesthetics, and innovative solutions. And we keep pushing the boundaries. We combine the best of tradition, technology and design in writing instruments, watches, leather goods, new technologies and selected accessories. With our name and in our emblem, we embody this mission: to implement bold ideas with outstanding craftsmanship and create refined products for people with highest expectations. In doing so, we are at the forefront of technology and design, drawing on the passion of more than 3,000 employees and living a culture that - like our products - inspires people to unleash their potential, to thrive and to achieve. Responsabilités Principales : 1. Conception et Développement :
• Concevoir et développer des mouvements horlogers mécaniques en utilisant des logiciels de CAO 2D et 3D PTC Creo et Tellwatch
• Réaliser les études de faisabilité technique et les analyses fonctionnelles des nouveaux mouvements ou des évolutions de mouvements existants.
• Définir les architectures mécaniques, les cinématiques et les tolérances dimensionnelles des composants.
• Intégrer les contraintes esthétiques, techniques, de coût et de production dès la phase de conception 2. Collaboration avec l’industrialisation et Prototypage :
• Établir les dossiers techniques complets (plans de fabrication, nomenclatures, spécifications techniques) pour le prototypage et la production.
• Collaborer avec l'atelier de prototypage et le chef de projet pour la réalisation des premières pièces et l'assemblage des mouvements.
• Participer aux phases de tests et de validation des prototypes, analyser les résultats et proposer des améliorations.
• Assurer le suivi technique lors de la phase d'industrialisation et de mise en production en série. 3. Optimisation et Amélioration Continue :
• Rechercher et proposer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la performance, la fiabilité, la précision et la facilité d'assemblage des mouvements.
• Optimiser les coûts de fabrication sans compromettre la qualité. 4. Collaboration et Communication :
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les designers, les horlogers, les méthodes, les chefs de projets et les équipes de production.
• Présenter les avancées techniques et les solutions aux équipes internes et à la direction.
• Participer aux revues de projet et aux réunions techniques. Qualifications Requises :
• Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur en microtechnique orientation horlogerie ou titre jugé équivalent
• Expérience : Minimum 5 années d'expérience significative dans la conception et le développement de mouvements horlogers complexes, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture de haute horlogerie. Compétences Techniques :
• Maîtrise approfondie des principes de la mécanique horlogère et des complications.
• Expertise des logiciels PTC Creo et Windchill
• Connaissance des matériaux horlogers et des procédés de fabrication (usinage, découpe, traitement de surface, etc.).
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans techniques complexes.
• Connaissance des normes et standards de l'industrie horlogère.
• Langues : Maîtrise du français Qualités Personnelles :
• Rigueur, précision et souci du détail.
• Créativité et esprit d'innovation.
• Capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Excellent esprit d'équipe et aptitudes à la communication.
• Passion pour l'horlogerie et la mécanique de précision. Similar Jobs Alternance - Richemont Retail Génération - Montblanc (H/F) Save Montblanc Stage long Assistant de Vente - Montblanc (H/F) Save Lyon, France Montblanc CDD - Sales Advisor (H/F) Save Marne La Vallee, France Montblanc

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130111 Da quando MONTBLANC ha rivoluzionato la cultura della scrittura nel 1906 con la prima penna stilografica a prova di versamento, siamo conosciuti per la straordinaria maestria artigianale, la massima estetica e le soluzioni innovative. E continuiamo a superare i limiti. Uniamo il meglio della tradizione, della tecnologia e del design negli strumenti da scrittura, negli orologi, nella pelletteria, nelle nuove tecnologie e negli accessori selezionati. Con il nostro nome e nel nostro stemma incarniamo questa missione: realizzare idee audaci con eccezionale maestria e creare prodotti raffinati per persone con le più alte aspettative. In tal modo, siamo all'avanguardia nella tecnologia e nel design, attingendo alla passione di oltre 3.000 dipendenti e vivendo una cultura che, come i nostri prodotti, ispira le persone a liberare il proprio potenziale, a prosperare e ad ottenere risultati. Principali responsabilità: 1. Progettazione e sviluppo:
• Progettare e sviluppare movimenti di orologi meccanici utilizzando i software CAD 2D e 3D PTC Creo e Tellwatch.
• Realizzare studi di fattibilità tecnica e analisi funzionali di nuovi movimenti o sviluppi di movimenti esistenti.
• Definire le architetture meccaniche, la cinematica e le tolleranze dimensionali dei componenti.
• Integrare vincoli estetici, tecnici, di costo e di produzione fin dalla fase di progettazione 2. Collaborazione con l'industrializzazione e la prototipazione:
• Stabilire fascicoli tecnici completi (piani di produzione, nomenclature, specifiche tecniche) per la prototipazione e la produzione.
• Collaborare con l'officina di prototipazione e il project manager per la produzione delle prime parti e l'assemblaggio dei movimenti.
• Partecipare alle fasi di test e validazione dei prototipi, analizzare i risultati e proporre miglioramenti.
• Garantire il monitoraggio tecnico durante la fase di industrializzazione e produzione di massa. 3. Ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo:
• Ricercare e proporre soluzioni innovative per migliorare le prestazioni, l'affidabilità, la precisione e la facilità di assemblaggio dei movimenti.
• Ottimizzare i costi di produzione senza compromettere la qualità. 4. Collaborazione e comunicazione:
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con designer, orologiai, metodi, project manager e team di produzione.
• Presentare i progressi tecnici e le soluzioni ai team interni e al management.
• Partecipare alle revisioni dei progetti e alle riunioni tecniche. Qualifiche richieste:
• Formazione: laurea in ingegneria in microtecnologia con specializzazione in orologeria o titolo ritenuto equivalente
• Esperienza: minimo 5 anni di esperienza significativa nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di movimenti di orologi complessi, idealmente all'interno di una fabbrica di alta orologeria. Competenze tecniche:
• Padronanza approfondita dei principi della meccanica e delle complicazioni dell'orologeria.
• Competenza nei software PTC Creo e Windchill.
• Conoscenza dei materiali e dei processi produttivi dell'orologeria (lavorazione meccanica, taglio, trattamento superficiale, ecc.).
• Capacità di leggere e interpretare progetti tecnici complessi.
• Conoscenza delle norme e degli standard del settore orologiero.
• Lingue: ottima conoscenza del francese. Qualità personali:
• Rigore, precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Creatività e spirito di innovazione.
• Capacità di analizzare e risolvere problemi complessi.
• Autonomia e proattività.
• Ottimo spirito di squadra e capacità di comunicazione.
• Passione per l'orologeria e la meccanica di precisione. Reference code: JR130111 Since MONTBLANC revolutionized writing culture in 1906 with the first spill-proof fountain pen, we have been known for outstanding craftsmanship, highest aesthetics, and innovative solutions. And we keep pushing the boundaries. We combine the best of tradition, technology and design in writing instruments, watches, leather goods, new technologies and selected accessories. With our name and in our emblem, we embody this mission: to implement bold ideas with outstanding craftsmanship and create refined products for people with highest expectations. In doing so, we are at the forefront of technology and design, drawing on the passion of more than 3,000 employees and living a culture that - like our products - inspires people to unleash their potential, to thrive and to achieve. Main Responsibilities: 1. Design and Development:
• Design and develop mechanical watch movements using 2D and 3D CAD software PTC Creo and Tellwatch
• Carry out technical feasibility studies and functional analyzes of new movements or developments of existing movements.
• Define the mechanical architectures, kinematics and dimensional tolerances of the components.
• Integrate aesthetic, technical, cost and production constraints from the design phase 2. Collaboration with industrialization and prototyping:
• Establish complete technical files (manufacturing plans, nomenclatures, technical specifications) for prototyping and production.
• Collaborate with the prototyping workshop and the project manager for the production of the first parts and the assembly of the movements.
• Participate in the testing and validation phases of prototypes, analyze the results and propose improvements.
• Ensure technical monitoring during the industrialization and mass production phase. 3. Optimization and Continuous Improvement:
• Research and propose innovative solutions to improve the performance, reliability, precision and ease of assembly of movements.
• Optimize manufacturing costs without compromising quality. 4. Collaboration and Communication:
• Work closely with designers, watchmakers, methods, project managers and production teams.
• Present technical advances and solutions to internal teams and management.
• Participate in project reviews and technical meetings. Required Qualifications:
• Training: Engineer's degree in microtechnology with a watchmaking focus or title deemed equivalent
• Experience: Minimum 5 years of significant experience in the design and development of complex watch movements, ideally within a fine watchmaking factory. Technical Skills:
• In-depth mastery of the principles of watchmaking mechanics and complications.
• Expertise in PTC Creo and Windchill software
• Knowledge of watchmaking materials and manufacturing processes (machining, cutting, surface treatment, etc.).
• Ability to read and interpret complex technical plans.
• Knowledge of watch industry norms and standards.
• Languages: Fluency in French Personal Qualities:
• Rigor, precision and attention to detail.
• Creativity and spirit of innovation.
• Ability to analyze and resolve complex problems.
• Autonomy and proactivity.
• Excellent team spirit and communication skills.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Referenzcode: JR130111 Seit MONTBLANC 1906 mit dem ersten auslaufsicheren Füllfederhalter die Schreibkultur revolutionierte, sind wir für herausragende Handwerkskunst, höchste Ästhetik und innovative Lösungen bekannt. Und wir verschieben immer wieder die Grenzen. Wir vereinen das Beste aus Tradition, Technologie und Design in Schreibgeräten, Uhren, Lederwaren, neuen Technologien und ausgewählten Accessoires. Mit unserem Namen und in unserem Emblem verkörpern wir diese Mission: mutige Ideen mit herausragender Handwerkskunst umzusetzen und raffinierte Produkte für Menschen mit höchsten Ansprüchen zu schaffen. Dabei stehen wir an der Spitze von Technologie und Design, schöpfen aus der Leidenschaft von mehr als 3.000 Mitarbeitern und leben eine Kultur, die – wie unsere Produkte – Menschen dazu inspiriert, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten, zu wachsen und etwas zu erreichen. Hauptaufgaben: 1. Design und Entwicklung:
• Design und Entwicklung mechanischer Uhrwerke mit der 2D- und 3D-CAD-Software PTC Creo und Tellwatch.
• Durchführung technischer Machbarkeitsstudien und Funktionsanalysen neuer Uhrwerke oder Weiterentwicklung bestehender Uhrwerke.
• Definieren Sie die mechanischen Architekturen, Kinematiken und Maßtoleranzen der Komponenten.
• Integrieren Sie ästhetische, technische, Kosten- und Produktionsbeschränkungen aus der Designphase 2. Zusammenarbeit mit Industrialisierung und Prototyping:
• Erstellen Sie vollständige technische Dateien (Fertigungspläne, Nomenklaturen, technische Spezifikationen) für Prototyping und Produktion.
• Zusammenarbeit mit der Prototyping-Werkstatt und dem Projektmanager bei der Produktion der ersten Teile und der Montage der Uhrwerke.
• Nehmen Sie an den Test- und Validierungsphasen von Prototypen teil, analysieren Sie die Ergebnisse und schlagen Sie Verbesserungen vor.
• Gewährleistung der technischen Überwachung während der Industrialisierungs- und Massenproduktionsphase. 3. Optimierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung:
• Erforschung und Vorschlag innovativer Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit, Präzision und einfachen Montage von Uhrwerken.
• Optimieren Sie die Herstellungskosten ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität. 4. Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation:
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Designern, Uhrmachern, Methoden, Projektmanagern und Produktionsteams.
• Präsentieren Sie technischen Fortschritten und Lösungen den internen Teams und dem Management.
• Nehmen Sie an Projektüberprüfungen und technischen Besprechungen teil. Erforderliche Qualifikationen:
• Ausbildung: Ingenieurabschluss in Mikrotechnik mit Schwerpunkt Uhrmacherei oder als gleichwertig angesehener Titel
• Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre umfassende Erfahrung in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung komplexer Uhrwerke, idealerweise in einer Feinuhrmacherfabrik. Technische Fähigkeiten:
• Vertiefte Beherrschung der Prinzipien der Uhrmachermechanik und der Komplikationen.
• Fachwissen in der Software PTC Creo und Windchill.
• Kenntnisse über Uhrenmaterialien und Herstellungsprozesse (Bearbeitung, Schneiden, Oberflächenbehandlung usw.).
• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Pläne zu lesen und zu interpretieren.
• Kenntnisse der Normen und Standards der Uhrenindustrie.
• Sprachen: Fließende Französischkenntnisse. Persönliche Qualitäten:
• Strenge, Präzision und Liebe zum Detail.
• Kreativität und Innovationsgeist.
• Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen.
• Autonomie und Proaktivität.
• Ausgezeichneter Teamgeist und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Leidenschaft für Uhrmacherei und Präzisionsmechanik.
