jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131779 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Company Overview: Our company is a major luxury group consisting of renowned luxury Maisons. As a leader in the luxury industry, we strive to maintain our prestigious reputation and continue driving innovation. The Group Data Office plays a pivotal role in developing the data strategy for the entire group and empowering each Maison to harness the power of data to create value and drive growth. Position Overview: As a key player in Richemont’s data transformation journey led by the Group Data Office, the Data Project Manager Intern will support the enablement of our Maisons, Functions, Divisions and Regions in their capacity to manage and leverage their data securely, autonomously and at scale. Within the Data Enablement team and reporting to our Senior Data Program Manager, the ideal candidate will support in the organization and orchestration of the transformation program for our business entities, focusing on change management, communication, and training coordination. 
• Responsibilities: Assist in Data Transformation Program Management: Help manage the portfolio of initiatives on the data transformation roadmap. Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including Group Technology, Analytics Enablement and Governance Enablement teams to create transformation roadmap, map interdependencies and track progress Collaborate with Maisons and Group Functions to define Data Transformation program objectives and scope. Data Transformation community animation: Support communities of practice or forums to facilitate collaboration on data transformation related initiatives. Build and organize resources, support materials and communication content to support and animate data transformation community Assist other program managers and team members with project management methodologies, tools, and techniques. Data Trainings and Communication support: Orchestrate our training and communication plan working closely alongside Data Office team members and key stakeholders. Work with our internal and external partners to define the communication and training content needs, plan resources accordingly. Review training content provided by contributors to align on messaging, tone and readability for the target audience Assist in Measuring and Communicating Impact: Help track key performance indicators to measure the impact of data enablement initiatives. Assist in providing regular updates on the progress and achievements. Help prepare communication on the success stories and benefits derived from data enablement. 
• Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong interest and knowledge in data, cloud, and related technologies. Experience with enterprise data platforms and/or data visualization tools is a plus. Previous experience in a project management or data related role is a plus. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Detail-oriented mindset with a proactive and problem-solving attitude. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to build trusted relationships within the team and across the organization. Proven creativity and analytical thinking, ability to break down complex tasks. Excellent written communication skills Fluent English is mandatory for this role. French is a plus. Luxury or retail business know-how is a plus. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? We are a very dynamic team, open-minded and extremely curious. We collaborate on many data projects from Business Insights to Artificial Intelligence with all businesses across the organization, from Manufacturing to Marketing or Sustainability and Retail, which makes every day enriching and fascinating. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a transformational program in a highly motivated team. We give real responsibilities to all team members, have a strong culture of feedback and love to collaborate! You will be partnering with all Maisons and Group Functions to deliver a key solution enabling our data projects and help us improve the value of our data assets. You will be based at our HQ in Bellevue, Geneva, with regular travel to the Meyrin and Fribourg campus site. To apply, please submit your CV YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you for an introductory call. 2. The next steps would be General and Technical interviews with our HR Business Partner, the hiring Manager, and the Data Office leadership members. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Internal Control Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Finance Senior Product Owner Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Press Relations Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR131905 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. YOUR MISSION: We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic intern to join our thriving Press Relations department for a 6-month internship. Within the department, your mission will be to assist the team in the organization and planning of press activities. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? According to the Marketing calendar, you will provide valuable support on the following topics: Assist the press team on the production, translation, and distribution of press material Coordinate with markets and internal departments for interview and shooting requests Bring logistical and operational support related to press attendance during HQ lead international events Ensure the seamless presence of press at press trips, including scheduling, travel arrangements and accommodations WHAT ABOUT YOU ? Currently pursuing a degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field, you are looking for an internship as of September 2026. You have experience in project management in public relations and a first experience in the luxury industry, fine watchmaking and high jewelry knowledge is a plus. You are fluent in English and French including excellent writing skills in both languages, and you are proficient in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, you are dynamic and enthusiastic to learn about PR, brand management, and marketing. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM US? All of our interns have a key role in our day-to-day business success. Moreover, the close collaboration with an engaged and dedicated team is there to support you to succeed in this challenging and exciting role. During your time with us, you will get familiar with our know-how and gain practical insights into different business areas. Best of all, you will grow in a stimulating environment with excellent working conditions and attractive benefits! descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR131905 Dal 1833, guidato da una sete incrollabile di innovazione e creatività, e ispirato dal tranquillo ambiente naturale della sua casa nella Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre si distingue per la sua padronanza delle complicazioni e la precisione dei suoi meccanismi. Conosciuto come Watchmaker of Watchmakers, la Manifattura ha espresso il suo spirito incessantemente inventivo attraverso la creazione di oltre 1.400 diversi calibri e il riconoscimento di oltre 430 brevetti. Sfruttando 190 anni di esperienza accumulata, i produttori orologiai La Grande Maison progettano, producono, rifiniscono e ornano i meccanismi più avanzati e precisi, fondendo la passione con la savoir-faire secolare, collegando il passato al futuro, senza tempo ma sempre al passo con i tempi. Con 180 competenze riunite sotto un unico tetto, la Manifattura crea orologi pregiati che combinano l'ingegno tecnico con la bellezza estetica e una sofisticazione contraddistinta. Siamo alla ricerca di uno stagista dinamico ed entusiasta per unire il nostro fiorente reparto relazioni stampa per uno stage di 6 mesi. All'interno del dipartimento, la vostra missione sarà di assistere il team nell'organizzazione e nella pianificazione delle attività di stampa. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Secondo il calendario Marketing, fornirete un valido supporto sui seguenti argomenti: Assistere il team di stampa alla produzione, alla traduzione e alla distribuzione di materiale di stampa Coordinate con i mercati e i dipartimenti interni per le richieste di interviste e di tiro Portate il supporto logistico e operativo relativo alla presenza della stampa durante il quartier generale con i principali eventi internazionali Assicurare la presenza senza soluzione di continuità di stampa durante i viaggi di stampa, tra cui la pianificazione, le modalità di viaggio e le sistemazioni Che cosa vi riguardano? Attualmente perseguendo una laurea in Comunicazione, Marketing, Relazioni Pubbliche, o un campo correlato, si sta cercando uno stage a partire da settembre 2026. Hai esperienza nella gestione del progetto nelle relazioni pubbliche e una prima esperienza nel settore del lusso, l'orologeria fine e l'alta conoscenza dei gioielli è un plus. Sei fluente in inglese e francese, tra cui eccellenti capacità di scrittura in entrambe le lingue, e sei competente in Word, Excel e PowerPoint. Organizzato e orientato al dettaglio, con la capacità di gestire più compiti e priorità, sei dinamico e entusiasta di conoscere PR, gestione del marchio e marketing. Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi? Tutti i nostri tirocinanti hanno un ruolo chiave nel nostro successo di affari di giorno per giorno. Inoltre, la stretta collaborazione con un team impegnato e dedicato è lì per aiutarvi a riuscire in questo ruolo impegnativo ed emozionante. Durante il vostro tempo con noi, avrete familiarità con il nostro know-how e ottenere informazioni pratiche in diverse aree di business. Meglio di tutti, crescerai in un ambiente stimolante con eccellenti condizioni di lavoro e benefici attraenti! descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR131905 Seit 1833, angetrieben von einem unstillbaren Durst nach Innovation und Kreativität und inspiriert von der ruhigen natürlichen Umgebung seines Hauses im Vallée de Joux, zeichnet sich Jaeger-LeCoultre durch seine Beherrschung der Komplikationen und die Präzision seiner Mechanismen aus. Bekannt als Uhrmacher der Uhrmacher, hat die Manufaktur ihren unerbittlichen Erfindergeist durch die Schaffung von mehr als 1.400 verschiedenen Kalibern und die Vergabe von mehr als 430 Patenten zum Ausdruck gebracht. Mit 190 Jahren gesammelter Expertise entwerfen, produzieren, fertigen und verzieren die Uhrmacher von La Grande Maison die fortschrittlichsten und präzisesten Mechanismen, verbinden Leidenschaft mit jahrhundertealtem Know-how und verbinden die Vergangenheit mit der Zukunft, zeitlos, aber immer mit der Zeit. Mit 180 Fähigkeiten, die unter einem Dach vereint sind, kreiert die Manufaktur feine Zeitmesser, die technischen Einfallsreichtum mit ästhetischer Schönheit und einer ausgeprägt dezenten Raffinesse verbinden. IHRE MISSION: Wir suchen einen dynamischen und enthusiastischen Praktikanten, der sich unserer florierenden Presseabteilung für ein 6-monatiges Praktikum anschließt. Innerhalb der Abteilung besteht Ihre Aufgabe darin, das Team bei der Organisation und Planung von Presseaktivitäten zu unterstützen. WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND? Gemäß dem Marketing-Kalender leisten Sie wertvolle Unterstützung zu folgenden Themen: Unterstützen Sie das Presseteam bei der Produktion, Übersetzung und Verteilung von Pressematerial Koordinieren Sie sich mit Märkten und internen Abteilungen für Interview- und Shooting-Anfragen Bringen Sie logistische und operative Unterstützung im Zusammenhang mit der Anwesenheit der Presse während internationaler Veranstaltungen des Hauptquartiers Sicherstellen Sie die nahtlose Präsenz der Presse auf Pressereisen, einschließlich Planung, Reisearrangements und Unterkünfte WAS ÜBER SIE? Organisiert und detailorientiert, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere
• Aufgaben und Prioritäten zu verwalten, sind Sie dynamisch und begeistert, über PR, Markenmanagement und Marketing zu lernen. Was können Sie von uns erwarten? descriptionByLocale.fr: Reference code: JR131905 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. YOUR MISSION: We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic intern to join our thriving Press Relations department for a 6-month internship. Within the department, your mission will be to assist the team in the organization and planning of press activities. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Currently pursuing a degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field, you are looking for an internship as of September 2026. You have experience in project management in public relations and a first experience in the luxury industry, fine watchmaking and high jewelry knowledge is a plus. You are fluent in English and French including excellent writing skills in both languages, and you are proficient in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, you are dynamic and enthusiastic to learn about PR, brand management, and marketing. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM US? All of our interns have a key role in our day-to-day business success. Moreover, the close collaboration with an engaged and dedicated team is there to support you to succeed in this challenging and exciting role. During your time with us, you will get familiar with our know-how and gain practical insights into different business areas. Best of all, you will grow in a stimulating environment with excellent working conditions and attractive benefits! jobs.title: Purchasing Excellence Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR131944 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Correspondez-vous au profil ? Vous maîtrisez la gestion de projet et démontrez une réelle capacité à accompagner et mener le changement au sein d'une organisation. Vous avez une excellente compréhension des enjeux business et une connaissance approfondie des outils, systèmes achats, procédures de compliance et pratiques d’achats durables. Doté(e) d'une forte appétence pour le digital, vous êtes à l'aise avec la manipulation de données, l'analyse et la construction de tableaux de bord (Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI, SAP). Vos qualités relationnelles et de communication vous permettent d'agir en véritable partenaire, de collaborer efficacement et d'engager activement des interlocuteurs variés. Vous faites preuve d’initiative, de responsabilité, d'autonomie et d'un engagement fort dans la réalisation de vos missions. Vous maîtrisez parfaitement l’anglais. Si tel est le cas, n’hésitez pas à postuler ! Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Rattaché(e) au Directeur Achats Indirects de la Maison, vous êtes le garant de l’excellence opérationnelle et de la compliance des process liés aux Achats Indirects. Vous accompagnez la Maison dans la digitalisation et l'harmonisation de ses pratiques via une approche end-to-end, en étroite synergie avec le Groupe et les autres Maisons. Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes : Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous implémentez les standards achats et qualité, optimisez les processus et menez les projets d'amélioration continue pour l'équipe sur l'ensemble des catégories d'Achats Indirects. Compliance & Gestion des Risques : Vous veillez à l’application de la Politique Achats de la Maison, pilotez les audits et assurez le suivi des plans d’actions associés. Transformation & Digitalisation : Vous travaillez à la digitalisation des processus achats/qualité et accompagnez le changement pour délivrer le maximum de valeur. Transmission : Vous développez et déployez des toolkits et des programmes de formation alignés avec les standards du Groupe pour accompagner la montée en compétences des équipes. Analyse & Reporting : Vous maintenez à jour les données achats, concevez et communiquez les tableaux de pilotage d’activité et assurez le reporting régulier des KPIs de l'équipe (du S2P au P2P). Animation de communauté : Vous contribuez activement à l'animation de la communauté Procurement Excellence au niveau de la Maison et du Groupe. Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière ! Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c’est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition. Vous bénéficierez d’une intégration complète avec des formations sur notre histoire, nos savoir-faire et créations, et un accompagnement au quotidien. Le processus de recrutement Postulez directement en ligne. Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l’équipe RH pour un entretien. Vous rencontrez ensuite par étape, le Directeur Achats Indirects de la Maison, puis les interlocuteurs clés de la Direction des Opérations. Le cas échéant, vous recevez un email vous informant du refus de votre candidature. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR131944 Chi siamo? Una High Jewelry House con un patrimonio forte che promuove un know-how eccezionale in un ambiente incantevole e creativo. La nostra Maison è alla ricerca di persone di talento che contribuiscono a sviluppare e trasmettere le loro competenze con cura e senza compromessi. A Van Cleef & Arpels sarete circondati da esperti appassionati e contribuirà a numerosi nuovi progetti che permettono alla nostra Maison di reinventarsi regolarmente. A Van Cleef & Arpels, siamo orgogliosi di attrarre talenti da diversi background ed esperienze. Crediamo che quando la diversità e l'inclusione sono pienamente abbracciati e potenziati, la creatività e la conoscenza emergono per offrire l'eccellenza. Corrisponde al profilo? Padroneggiare la gestione del progetto e dimostrare una reale capacità di supportare e condurre il cambiamento all'interno di un'organizzazione. Hai una eccellente comprensione delle questioni aziendali e una conoscenza approfondita di strumenti, sistemi di acquisto, procedure di conformità e pratiche di acquisto sostenibili. Con un forte appeal digitale, sei a tuo agio con la manipolazione dei dati, l'analisi e la costruzione di dashboard (Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI, SAP). Le vostre qualità di relazione e di comunicazione permettono di agire come un vero partner, collaborare efficacemente e attivamente coinvolgere interlocutori diversi. Voi dimostrate l'iniziativa, la responsabilità, l'autonomia e un forte impegno per l'adempimento delle vostre missioni. Sei fluente in inglese. Se è così, non esitate a fare domanda! Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? Attaccato al Indirect Purchasing Director of the House, sei il garante dell'eccellenza operativa e della conformità dei processi relativi all'Indirect Purchasing. Voi appoggiate la Camera nella digitalizzazione e nell'armonizzazione delle sue pratiche attraverso un approccio end-to-end, in stretta sinergia con il Gruppo e con altre Case. Le tue responsabilità includono: Eccellenza Operativa: implementa gli standard di acquisto e qualità, ottimizza i processi e conduce progetti di miglioramento continuo per il team in tutte le categorie di Acquisti Indiretti. Compliance & Risk Management: monitora l'attuazione della politica di acquisto casa, gestisce gli audit e monitora i piani d'azione associati. Trasformazione e digitalizzazione: Lei lavora sulla digitalizzazione dei processi di acquisto/qualità e accompagna il cambiamento per offrire il massimo valore. Trasmissione: Lei sviluppa e distribuisce strumenti e programmi di formazione allineati con gli standard del Gruppo per supportare lo sviluppo delle competenze del team. Analisi & Reporting: Mantenere i dati di acquisto aggiornati, progettare e comunicare i tavoli di sterzo attività e garantire una regolare segnalazione dei KPI del team (da S2P a P2P). Animazione comunitaria: Lei contribuisce attivamente alla leadership della comunità di Eccellenza Procurement a livello di Casa e Gruppo. Più di un lavoro... Stiamo reclutando per una carriera! Integrare Van Cleef & Arpels è soprattutto un team in cui lo sviluppo dei dipendenti è al centro della nostra ambizione. Potrai beneficiare della piena integrazione con la formazione sulla nostra storia, il nostro know-how e creazioni, e il supporto quotidiano. Il processo di reclutamento Applicare direttamente online. Se il tuo profilo viene selezionato, sei contattato dal team HR per un'intervista. Poi si incontrano in fasi, il direttore della Camera di appalti indiretti, e poi gli interlocutori chiave della Direzione Operazioni. Se necessario, riceverete una e-mail informandovi del rifiuto della vostra richiesta. jobs.title: International Senior Finance Controller
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132089 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. WHAT DO WE OFFER At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive. We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences. 
• We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity. We celebrate every achievement, big or small, fostering meaningful connections through gratitude and mutual support, nurturing a sense of belonging. Join us at Cartier, a place like no other, forever moving forward. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT Reporting to the International Controlling Distribution Director, in Cartier’s Finance team, this role will contribute to the overall Finance function by managing financial performance for specific Regions. As the business link between the Cartier markets (Managing director, local financial controller) and the International Finance Direction, you will both challenge their performance to ensure alignment to Cartier’s strategy as well as support them in realizing their financial objectives. You will also be managing one of the transversal P&L line items, such as Capex or Opex across the Maison. Regional Controlling Guide and challenge regional long-term financial planning (“Financial Dynamics”) and support the strategic business plan. Ensure optimal working capital and resource allocation in line with Maison strategy; highlight risks and opportunities (e.g., boutique investments). Identify cost-saving opportunities and support regional management in driving operational efficiency. Financial Planning, Performance Reporting & Analysis Support the coordination of regional budgeting and monthly forecasting processes according to HQ and Group guidelines. Analyze monthly results for multiple subsidiaries (costs, DSO, Capex, headcount, margins, and discounts). Monitor and report on consolidated operating expenses (monthly follow-up, budgeting, and ad-hoc analysis). Lead the development and optimization of management reporting tools. Conduct regional performance analyses (e.g., commission schemes, profitability). Transversal Projects Partner with business stakeholders to design and execute solutions for complex business challenges. Other 
• Responsibilities Collaborate on preparing and participating in major finance presentations (Executive Committee, Monthly Updates, Budget meetings). Support and champion a strong internal control culture within the Maison. Ensure active compliance with company policies, procedures, and IAS standards. WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR You have a Master’s Degree in Finance with 5 to 8 years of experience in a multi-cultural, matrixed environment (ideally within FMCG or a multinational Audit firm). Proven track record of managing, budgeting, and reporting against a full, sizeable P&L and Balance Sheet. Solid understanding of Management Accounting under IFRS, and the connection between reporting, accounting, and financial controls. Excellent analytical and synthesis skills with the ability to evaluate consolidated international data (from manufacturing to distribution). Outstanding communication skills to build close relationships with regional management; fluent English is required, and French is a plus. Proactive mindset with a strong ability to anticipate business issues and propose strategic solutions. Highly proficient in financial query and BI tools such as SAP (SEM & BW), Anaplan, PowerBI, or Looker. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will give you an introductory call to explain further steps and discuss the opportunity. If things go well on both ends, you will have a chance to meet the International Controlling Distribution Director and the HR Team. Take your next step with Cartier, we look forward to hearing from you! descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR132089 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. A Cartier, farai parte di una comunità legata da un forte senso di responsabilità, dove la connessione, la collaborazione e lo spirito collettivo prosperano. Potenziamo i singoli talenti, uniti da un impegno condiviso per l'eccellenza, ispirato alle diverse culture del mondo, per rispettare e arricchire il nostro patrimonio unico. Crediamo che diverse prospettive alimentano l'innovazione e ci spingono a creare esperienze eccezionali.
• Offriamo un ambiente energizzante per la crescita della carriera e l'opportunità di contribuire la vostra visione individuale a un'eredità di creatività. Celebriamo ogni risultato, grande o piccolo, promuovendo connessioni significative attraverso la gratitudine e il sostegno reciproco, alimentando un senso di appartenenza. Unisciti a noi a Cartier, un posto come nessun altro, per sempre andare avanti. HOW WILL MAKE AN IMPACT Reporting to the International Controlling Distribution Director, nel team di Cartier Finance, questo ruolo contribuirà alla funzione Finance generale gestendo le prestazioni finanziarie per specifiche Regioni. Come il collegamento commerciale tra i mercati di Cartier (Gestione direttore, controllore finanziario locale) e la Direzione di finanza internazionale, entrambi si sfideranno le loro prestazioni per garantire l'allineamento alla strategia di Cartier e supportarli nella realizzazione dei loro obiettivi finanziari. Potrai anche gestire uno dei prodotti della linea P&L trasversale, come Capex o Opex attraverso la Maison. Guida di controllo regionale e sfida la pianificazione finanziaria regionale a lungo termine (“Dinamici finanziarie”) e sostenere il piano strategico aziendale. Assicurare un capitale di lavoro ottimale e l'allocazione delle risorse in linea con la strategia Maison; evidenziare rischi e opportunità (ad esempio, investimenti in boutique). Identificare le opportunità di risparmio e sostenere la gestione regionale nella guida dell'efficienza operativa. Sostenere il coordinamento dei processi di bilancio regionale e di previsione mensile secondo le linee guida HQ e Group. Analizzare i risultati mensili per più filiali (costi, DSO, Capex, headcount, margini e sconti). Monitorare e riferire le spese operative consolidate (controllo mensile, bilancio e analisi ad hoc). Guidare lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione degli strumenti di reporting di gestione. Condurre analisi delle prestazioni regionali (ad esempio, schemi di commissioni, redditività). Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali per progettare ed eseguire soluzioni per complesse sfide aziendali. Altri
• Responsabilità Collaborare per la preparazione e la partecipazione a importanti presentazioni finanziarie (Comitato esecutivo, aggiornamenti mensili, riunioni di bilancio). Sostenere e sostenere una forte cultura di controllo interno all'interno della Maison. Assicurare il rispetto attivo delle politiche aziendali, delle procedure e degli standard IAS. Che cosa stiamo cercando Hai una laurea magistrale in finanza con 5-8 anni di esperienza in un ambiente multi-culturale, matrice (idealmente all'interno di FMCG o una multinazionale Audit ditta). Provato record di gestione, budgeting e reporting contro un P&L e Balance Sheet di dimensioni complete. Solida comprensione della contabilità gestionale ai sensi dell'IFRS, e la connessione tra reporting, contabilità e controlli finanziari. Ottimi competenze analitiche e di sintesi con la capacità di valutare i dati internazionali consolidati (dalla produzione alla distribuzione). Competenze di comunicazione eccezionali per costruire relazioni strette con la gestione regionale; inglese fluente è richiesto, e francese è un plus. Mindset attivo con una forte capacità di anticipare i problemi aziendali e proporre soluzioni strategiche. Altamente abile in query finanziaria e strumenti BI come SAP (SEM & BW), Anaplan, PowerBI o Looker. TUA GIORNATA CON NOI Se la vostra applicazione è selezionata, vi daremo una chiamata introduttiva per spiegare ulteriori passi e discutere l'opportunità. Se le cose vanno bene su entrambe le estremità, avrete la possibilità di incontrare il Direttore di Distribuzione di Controllo Internazionale e il Team HR. Fai il tuo prossimo passo con Cartier, non vediamo l'ora di sentire da te! Assicurare e gestire la corretta comprensione e l'esecuzione delle politiche e delle procedure di consegna della Maison e assistere con audit semestrali. Supporto di rete e gestione delle relazioni (40%) Essere il punto di ingresso per richieste di boutique interne, gestori di aree e partner all'ingrosso Gestire richieste relative alla disponibilità del prodotto, prezzi, consegne e reclami Fornire aggiornamenti di spedizione e ordine Assist su SAP/Booster Apertura / Chiusure di POS e luoghi di evento (apertura dell'ordine azionario, configurazione SAP, manutenzione dei dati master) PO Creazione e follow-up per Capex e fatture Assicurare il follow-up di attivazione della garanzia in Booster Support vendita al dettaglio e all'ingrosso durante gli eventi aziendali, la produzione e la gestione delle visite operative Essere di supporto per comprendere le prestazioni del mercato Aggiornato e creare dashboard per monitorare le prestazioni del mercato Analisi delle prestazioni del prodotto e della boutique Gestione del supporto durante le recensioni aziendali e previsioni di vendita settimanali Systems & Process Governance – SAP / Booster (10%) Assicurare che i processi aziendali siano correttamente compresi ed eseguiti in piena conformità Act come utente chiave per SAP e Booster sistemi Test SAP/Booster releases e piloti Assicurare processi aziendali sono correttamente eseguiti e compresi

jobs.title: Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132092 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. MAIN PURPOSE The Group Sustainability team has progressed with the consolidation and integration of its Non-Financial Reporting Framework, specifically building on the Swiss Non-Financial Reporting requirements. Looking ahead, the fast-moving Non-Financial Reporting landscape, driven by a growing number of regulatory requirements, entails the ongoing enhancement of non-financial reporting processes. In this context, the Sustainability Transformation team's primary objectives are to oversee the Non-Financial Reporting Framework, and support the continuous improvement of the Group Sustainability Framework. KEY RESPONSIBILITES The Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern will assume a key role in the following areas: Provide assistance in the continuous improvement of the Richemont Non-Financial Reporting Framework, ensuring alignment with the GRI and other relevant Standards; Support the ESRS gap assessment and the formalisation of improvement plans; Support the critical review of GRI disclosures and the ongoing update of required documentation (e.g. GRI Index; Basis of Preparation); Support the critical review of regulatory requirements (e.g. CSRD), including benchmark analysis; Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely reporting; Support the team in collecting, analysing non-financial information (e.g. content collection template update), conducting data quality check to ensure accuracy and completeness of non-financial reporting; Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting processes and tools, including digital solutions. SKILLS Excellent written and verbal communication Self-motivated, strong work ethic, very strong organisational skills Proven ability to meet deadlines and work on multiple projects simultaneously Excellent attention to detail, thoroughness Ability to anticipate needs by being proactive not reactive A first experience within the luxury industry is an asset Keen interest and understanding of sustainability topics Ability to work cross-functionally and build relationships in the Group PROFILE Previous first experience in corporate sustainability preferred Master degree in Sustainability, Economics or related field Knowledge of GRI, CSRD, ESRS, EU Taxonomy Detailed oriented and analytical Fluent in English required, good knowledge of French preferred Proactive and flexible Good command of Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint, Word Good communication skills Experience working in multi-stakeholder initiatives, whether at University or other #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs International Compliance Risk Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Cartier Director, Risk & Compliance Save New York, United States of America Richemont Group Procurement Data and Analytics Senior Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont

Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. MAIN PURPOSE The Group Sustainability team has progressed with the consolidation and integration of its Non-Financial Reporting Framework, specifically building on the Swiss Non-Financial Reporting requirements. Looking ahead, the fast-moving Non-Financial Reporting landscape, driven by a growing number of regulatory requirements, entails the ongoing enhancement of non-financial reporting processes. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR132092 Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux produits de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. PRINCIPAUX OBJECTIFS L'équipe de développement durable du Groupe a progressé dans la consolidation et l'intégration de son cadre d'information non financière, en s'appuyant notamment sur les exigences suisses en matière d'information non financière. En ce qui concerne l'avenir, l'évolution rapide des rapports non financiers, en raison d'un nombre croissant d'exigences réglementaires, entraîne l'amélioration continue des processus de rapports non financiers. Dans ce contexte, les principaux objectifs de l'équipe de transformation de la durabilité sont de superviser le cadre de rapports non financiers et d'appuyer l'amélioration continue du cadre de durabilité du groupe. PRINCIPAUX RESPONSABILITES Le stagiaire de l'analyste de la transformation de la durabilité assumera un rôle clé dans les domaines suivants : Fournir de l'aide pour l'amélioration continue du cadre de rapports non financiers de Richemont, en assurant l'harmonisation avec l'IRG et d'autres normes pertinentes; Appuyer l'évaluation des lacunes de l'ESRS et l'officialisation des plans d'amélioration; Appuyer l'examen critique des divulgations de l'IRSG et la mise à jour continue de la documentation requise (p. ex., l'indice de l'IRSG; la base de préparation); Appuyer l'examen critique des exigences réglementaires (p. ex., le CSRD), y compris l'analyse de référence; Collaborer avec les équipes interfonctionnelles afin d'assurer l'exactitude et le respect des délais de présentation des rapports; Aider l'équipe à recueillir, analyser les informations non financières (p. ex., la mise à jour du modèle de collecte de contenu), effectuer des vérifications de la qualité des données pour assurer l'exactitude et l'exhaustivité des rapports non financiers; Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus et des outils de présentation des rapports, y compris les solutions numériques. jobs.description: Reference code: JR132208 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT As a Test Manager intern, you will become a key member of our Quality Assurance team, contributing to the harmonisation of testing practices and the exploration and implementation of AI-driven testing solutions across our domain. You will work closely with an existing Test Manager, embedded in a Product team, reporting to a senior member of the QA leadership. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? (Mention 3 quantitative responsibilities) By bringing valuable insights and a quality-focused mindset, you will contribute to the evolution of our testing landscape. Support the harmonisation of testing methodologies: Assist in documenting, standardizing, and promoting best practices for testing within & across various product teams, aiming for improved efficiency and consistency in our ways of working. Contribute to AI for testing initiatives: Participate in the research, exploration, and initial implementation phases of AI-powered testing tools and strategies, helping to identify potential use cases and measure their impact on testing efficiency and coverage. Collaborate with Test Managers embedded in Product Areas: Work alongside embedded Test Managers to understand their specific testing challenges, gather requirements for harmonisation efforts, and support the integration of new testing approaches and tools. Assist in the preparation of test strategies, test plans, and test reports. Help organize and facilitate workshops or training sessions related to new testing tools or methodologies. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? (What skills do they need to succeed) You are doing a master's degree or are recently graduated (Business or Engineering School) with a strong interest in software quality assurance, testing methodologies, and emerging technologies like AI. You can follow a rapid learning curve and show impactful results (be a doer) after a short discovery phase. You can understand transversal topics from IT to Business requirements, with an ability to grasp the big picture of quality assurance within a large organization. You have a quality-orientated mindset, with an eye for detail and can propose improvements in our testing processes and deliverables. You are effective in communication and can work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and other test managers. You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges in a dynamic environment. Eager to master Test Management and Quality Assurance within an IT environment Skilled in Microsoft 360 (Teams, PowerPoint, Excel & Word), know-how of Atlassian Suite is a bonus. Strong proficiency in English and French is a must. You are available for a 6-month internship with a start date in April 2026 You are eligible for an internship agreement. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? (Work environment and culture) At Richemont, we believe in fostering an environment where every team member can thrive and feel valued. As an Intern Test Manager, you will: Be part of a dynamic and supportive team: Enjoy the various personalities of our team, participate in regular team events, and engage in a variety of activities that promote collaboration and camaraderie. Benefit from mentorship and learning: Work closely with experienced professionals who are dedicated to your growth, providing guidance and opportunities to expand your skills in quality assurance and AI for testing. Contribute to meaningful projects: Your work will directly impact the quality and efficiency of our different scope of activities, giving you a sense of purpose and achievement. Enjoy a stimulating and innovative atmosphere: Be at the forefront of exploring new technologies like AI in testing, contributing to the future of quality assurance within a leading luxury group. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first technical interview with Nathalie Cappelletti; and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs QA Development Lead Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Program Management intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Quality Engineer — Omnichannel Order Execution Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. BACKGROUND Embark on a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the financial landscape of our Group Platforms department. In this transversal role, you will drive essential financial activities, primarily focusing on cost controlling, financial planning, and internal allocation model management. 
• Your responsibilities will be dynamically split, with 70% dedicated to hands-on controlling tasks, working closely with managers to ensure financial rigor, and 30% focused on providing essential support to the wider controlling team, particularly in enhancing data quality and streamlining administrative functions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As part of Group Finance and based in Meyrin, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas: Drive Financial Performance & Control Oversee day-to-day financial operations for our technology domains and cost centers, ensuring efficient and appropriate financial control systems. Actively contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, including preparing accruals, reviewing commitments, and assisting with allocation cycles. Partner closely with Group Technology Managers to foster cost awareness and enhance understanding of financial performance, providing insightful analysis and ad-hoc reports. Support the tracking and monitoring of resources for key technology projects and initiatives. Master Planning & Forecasting Play a key role in the planning and forecasting cycles (Budget, Latest Estimate, Roadmap), from data collection and analysis to presentation and report preparation. Assist in the review and consolidation of budget components (Investments, Operating expenses, Headcounts) for supported areas. Prepare preliminary management reports and conduct initial variance analysis against financial targets. Ensure Financial Integrity & Compliance Support the Capital Approval Request (CAR) process and contribute to the follow-up of financial commitments, including budget assumption validation and vendor contract checks. Assist in the control and validation of Purchase Orders (PO) in close collaboration with the P2P team. Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of cost allocation models, ensuring accurate evaluation of internal and business services. Support the application of Richemont's internal controlling procedures, identifying and addressing potential gaps. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Conduct regular and thorough checks on financial data quality within systems, particularly for time allocation entries and master data accuracy. Identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data integrity issues. Assist in collecting, validating, and consolidating financial data from various sources for reporting and analysis. Contribute to identifying and implementing process improvements within the controlling function, focusing on automation and efficiency. Provide support for ad-hoc financial analysis, data extraction, and special projects as required. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Strong team spirit and communication skills with aptitude to collaborate transversally across various teams, organizations, and stakeholders. Curious to learn, develop, and contribute to challenging the status-quo. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an ability to pay close attention to detail. Good organizational abilities with proactivity, and keen to work independently while managing ambiguity with guidance when necessary. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, and balance multiple priorities. Education, experience and core competencies University graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 1 to 3 years’ experience in a finance or controlling role, preferably within a multinational environment. Relevant internships will be considered. Familiarity with SAP FICO, Anaplan and/or BI tools is an asset. Knowledge of coding languages (like Python), AI prompts (Copilot), and/or RPA. Strong proficiency in Excel is required Demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. Fluent in English, French knowledge is a strong asset. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value curiosity, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, excellence, courage, collaboration, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs International Finance A&P Senior Controller Save Meyrin, Switzerland Cartier Europe FP&A Controller Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont FP&A Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont

Reference code: JR132397 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Team Performance Training Department we are looking for an INTERN TEAM PERFORMANCE TRAINING (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: November 2026 In this stimulating internship, you are working on HQ Team Performance Training projects while being in close contact with our international platforms, giving a global dimension to this position. The role is allocated within the Global Commercial Team and reports directly to the Global Head of Team Performance and Digital Training. YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Ad-hoc analysis of global commercial KPIs. Preparation and analysis of sales data for market coaching, market visits and executive management presentations. Creation and further development of existing coaching and training tools, content, roadmaps, tracking, feedback coordination, etc. Support with creation of digital training content via our internal app and presentation content related to product, service and performance. Support virtual studio operation and creation of studio presentations. Organization and coordination of large HQ-trainings (approx. 2-3 trainings per internship). Support for the Team Performance Training Team with additional needs in administration, budgeting, reporting, new project management etc. HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. 
• Your profile should combine both quantitative (e.g., analytical thinking, number crunching, etc.) and qualitative (e.g., creative ideas, design affinity, etc.) skills: Currently enrolled or recently graduated from a bachelor's or master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality or similar. First experience in the field of Sales / Retail / Marketing / Finance / Consulting is a plus. Team player with strong analytical and project management skills. Independent, dedicated and highly motivated individual with a high affinity for our brand and strong enthusiasm for our products. Proactive and flexible mindset with a hands-on mentality. Very strong digital tool knowledge and at ease with different software solutions, especially Excel and PowerPoint (SAP knowledge is an asset). Fluent in English (excellent written and verbal communication) is a must and any other language is a plus. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132340 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. As part of its strategic development in Switzerland, Buccellati is looking for a Boutique Manager capable to handle the opening and success of the boutique. Your mission: As an Ambassador of the Buccellati Maison, you will be responsible of the development and optimization of the boutique performance and profitability by managing the boutique team, ensuring excellence in boutique operations and in delivering the best client service and experience. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. You will be in charge of the daily operations of the boutique (front and back office) with the aim to communicate the overall brand message in a successful manner to generate business. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining and promoting the Buccellati brand image and identity, following the Company’s directives. You will be accountable for ensuring maximum sales and profitability of the boutique through merchandise, inventory, expense control and human resources management. Your Key 
• Responsibilities: Boutique performance & Sales achievement: Achieve or surpass monthly and yearly sales targets of the boutique; Meet or exceed the KPI’s set by Retail Management; Respect the brand’s discount policy; Establish budget, track sales and expenses. Maintain budget and related costs within established guidelines; Develop and implement the boutique action plan with the commercial department with a focus on business development; Ensure the sales growth; Gain market share; Review competition trends, recommend and initiate changes for maximizing goals and objectives; Management: Set, implement and supervise the Boutique sales strategy; Guarantee the implementation and regular monitoring of the Boutique action plan (Result driven, monthly review and keep update, monitor and follow up the plan); Ensure compliance with all policies and procedures through regular store management and staff meetings, store walk-through, audits .. ; Together with the Visual Merchandising Team, ensure that the standards on store image are kept according to Company guidelines and coordinate the proper training for sales staff; Ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels; Ensure proper attire, grooming and behavior in line with the brand’s guidelines; Grant the compliance to operational procedures provided by the Group; Lead by example & Team spirit: lead and motivate the team to accomplish and maximize the sales target and retail KPIs; Oversee the boutique maintenance; Handle all customer’s enquiries and complaints; Customer Relations Management: Treat the customer according to brand’s standards: ensure that each customer receives outstanding standards, solid product knowledge and all other components of Customer Service; Act as a Brand Ambassador when representing the Brand at meetings, events (local & international) and other work-related functions; Build strong customer relationships and enhance loyalty; Acquire a relevant customer database, convert into sales transaction and retain the customer for future transactions; Monitor & execute the Boutique CRM program; Team Management: Performs all necessary supervisory functions to effectively and efficiently manage the personnel assigned: Hire, lead and act as advisor to boutique team regarding projects, tasks and operations; Define and communicate missions and objectives of all team members, clearly establishing priorities and reasonable deadlines; Formulate sales team’s goals and objectives, motivate staff and reinforce engagement; Motivate the boutique team around the strategy and vision of the Maison; Fosters a cooperative and harmonious working climate to maximize employees morale and productivity; Act as a coach and assist the colleagues in operations, sales and training; Job profile: Bachelor graduated with at least 10 years retail experience, preferably in luxury jewelry/watchmaking sector; Qualification/ training in watches & jewelry, knowledge of diamond grading and design; Preferably with qualification in gemology; Ability to work in a fast-paced retail store environment; MS Office experience required (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Fluency in English and French is mandatory; the knowledge of another language is a plus (Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Italian); Personal Skills: Managerial skills and proactive approach; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are required; Ability to delegate tasks and follow up to ensure execution; People friendly and comfortable dealing with VIP clients; Excellent representation skills; Focused, target oriented and organized; Strong understanding of Customer Service needs and Customer (internal and external) priorities; Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision; Self-Starter with Team-Player approach; Similar Jobs Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Stock Administrator Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR132340 Buccellati è una rinomata Maison italiana di alto livello fondata nel 1919, ammirata per la sua artigianalità e l'unicità delle sue creazioni. Oggi, i gioielli Buccellati si distinguono per il loro design e per le tecniche utilizzate per crearli, come la tecnica d’incisione a mano, risalente alle antiche tradizioni orafe della “bottega” italiana nel periodo rinascimentale. Buccellati fa parte del Global Luxury Group Richemont da settembre 2019, ma la famiglia Buccellati è ancora presente in azienda con funzioni manageriali di alto livello. Le boutique Buccellati sono presenti nelle città più importanti e nei centri commerciali più prestigiosi del mondo. Nell'ambito del suo sviluppo strategico in Svizzera, Buccellati sta cercando un Boutique Manager in grado di gestire l'apertura e il successo della boutique. La vostra missione: In qualità di Ambasciatore della Maison Buccellati, sarete responsabili dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e della redditività della boutique gestendo il team di boutique, garantendo l'eccellenza nelle operazioni di boutique e offrendo il miglior servizio e l'esperienza dei clienti. Contribuirai a sviluppare una profonda comprensione e conoscenza della Maison per trasmettere il suo DNA di marca, l'artigianato riconoscibile e l'innovazione in tutte le sue creazioni. Sarete responsabili delle operazioni quotidiane della boutique (front e back office) con l'obiettivo di comunicare il messaggio generale del marchio in modo efficace per generare business. Sarete responsabili di stabilire, mantenere e promuovere l’immagine e l’identità del marchio Buccellati, seguendo le direttive della Società. Sarete responsabili per garantire la massima vendita e redditività della boutique attraverso merce, inventario, controllo delle spese e gestione delle risorse umane. La tua chiave
• Responsabilità: performance di Boutique & Vendite: raggiungere o superare gli obiettivi di vendita mensili e annuali della boutique; soddisfare o superare il set di KPI da Retail Management; rispettare la politica di sconto del marchio; stabilire budget, monitorare le vendite e le spese. Mantenere il budget e i relativi costi all'interno di linee guida stabilite; Sviluppare e implementare il piano d'azione boutique con il reparto commerciale con un focus sullo sviluppo aziendale; Assicurare la crescita delle vendite; Gain quota di mercato; rivedere le tendenze della concorrenza, raccomandare e avviare modifiche per massimizzare gli obiettivi e gli obiettivi; Gestione: Impostare, implementare e supervisionare la strategia di vendita Boutique; Garantire l'implementazione e il monitoraggio regolare del piano d'azione Boutique (Risultato guidato, revisione mensile e mantenere l'aggiornamento, monitorare e seguire il piano); Assicurare il rispetto di tutte le politiche e procedure attraverso la gestione regolare del negozio e riunioni del personale, negozio walk-through, audit .. ; Assieme al Visual Merchandising Team, assicurarsi che gli standard sull'immagine del negozio siano mantenuti secondo le linee guida della Società e coordinare la corretta formazione per il personale di vendita; Assicurarsi un abbigliamento adeguato, la cura e il comportamento in linea con le linee guida del marchio; Concedere la conformità alle procedure operative previste dal Gruppo; Guidare per esempio & Team spirit: guidare e motivare il team a realizzare e massimizzare il target di vendita e i KPI retail; Superare la manutenzione della boutique; gestire tutte le richieste e i reclami del cliente; Customer Relations Management: Trattare il cliente secondo gli standard del marchio: assicurarsi che ogni cliente riceva standard eccezionali, conoscenze dei prodotti solidi e tutti gli altri componenti del Servizio Clienti; agire come Brand Ambassador quando rappresenta il Brand in riunioni, eventi (locali e internazionali) e altre funzioni connesse al lavoro; Costruire forti relazioni con i clienti e migliorare la fedeltà; Acquisire un database clienti rilevante, convertire in transazioni di vendita e mantenere il cliente per le transazioni future; Monitorare ed eseguire il programma Boutique CRM; Team Management: Esegui tutte le funzioni di supervisione necessarie per gestire efficacemente ed efficacemente il personale assegnato: Assumere, guidare e agire come consulente del team di boutique per progetti, compiti e operazioni; Definire e comunicare le missioni e gli obiettivi di tutti i membri del team, stabilire chiaramente le priorità e le scadenze ragionevoli; Formulare obiettivi e obiettivi del team di vendita, motivare il personale e rafforzare il coinvolgimento; Motivare il team boutique intorno alla strategia e alla visione della Maison; promuove un clima di lavoro cooperativo e armonioso per massimizzare il morale e la produttività dei dipendenti; Atto come allenatore e assistere i colleghi in operazioni, vendite e formazione; Profilo del lavoro: Bachelor laureato con almeno 10 anni di esperienza al dettaglio, preferibilmente nel settore dei gioielli di lusso / orologi; Qualificazione / formazione in orologi e gioielli, conoscenza del grading di diamante e design; Preferibilmente con la qualifica in gemologia; Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio veloce; Esperienza di MS Office richiesto (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Competenze di rappresentanza eccellenti; Focused, target oriented e organizzato; Forte comprensione delle esigenze del Servizio Clienti e priorità del Cliente (interni ed esterni); Forte attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di gestire più compiti simultaneamente e con precisione; Self-Starter con approccio Team-Player; Simili Jobs Sales Associate -Abu Dhabi Save Dubai, Emirati Arabi Uniti Buccellati Boutique Director Save Bal Harbour, Stati Uniti d'America Buccellati Assistant Boutique Manager Save Dubai, Emirati Arabi Uniti Buccellati

Bezugscode: JR132340 Buccellati ist ein renommiertes italienisches Hochschmuckhaus, das 1919 gegründet wurde und für seine Handwerkskunst und die Einzigartigkeit seiner Kreationen bewundert wird. Heute zeichnen sich die Buccellati-Juwelen durch ihr Design und die zu ihrer Herstellung verwendeten Techniken aus, wie die Handgravurtechnik, die auf die alten Goldschmiedetraditionen der italienischen "Bottega" während der Renaissance zurückgeht. Buccellati ist seit September 2019 Teil der Global Luxury Group Richemont, aber die Buccellati-Familie ist immer noch mit Führungsfunktionen auf höchster Ebene im Unternehmen präsent. Buccellati Boutiquen sind in den wichtigsten Städten und in den renommiertesten Malls der Welt präsent. Im Rahmen der strategischen Entwicklung in der Schweiz sucht Buccellati einen Boutique Manager, der in der Lage ist, die Eröffnung und den Erfolg der Boutique zu bewältigen. Ihre Mission: Als Botschafter der Buccellati Maison sind Sie für die Entwicklung und Optimierung der Boutique-Leistung und -Rentabilität verantwortlich, indem Sie das Boutique-Team leiten, Exzellenz im Boutique-Betrieb sicherstellen und den besten Kundenservice und die beste Kundenerfahrung bieten. Sie werden dazu beitragen, ein tiefes Verständnis und Wissen über die Maison zu entwickeln, um ihre Marken-DNA, erkennbare Handwerkskunst und Innovation in all ihren Kreationen zu vermitteln. Sie sind verantwortlich für den täglichen Betrieb der Boutique (Front- und Backoffice) mit dem Ziel, die gesamte Markenbotschaft erfolgreich zu kommunizieren, um Geschäfte zu generieren. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, das Image und die Identität der Marke Buccellati gemäß den Richtlinien des Unternehmens zu etablieren, zu pflegen und zu fördern. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, den maximalen Verkauf und die Rentabilität der Boutique durch Waren, Inventar, Kostenkontrolle und Personalmanagement zu gewährleisten. Dein Schlüssel
• Verantwortlichkeiten: Boutiquenleistung & Verkaufsleistung: Monatliche und jährliche Verkaufsziele der Boutique erreichen oder übertreffen; Die von Retail Management festgelegten KPIs erfüllen oder übertreffen; Die Rabattpolitik der Marke respektieren; Budget festlegen, Verkäufe und Ausgaben verfolgen. Pflegen Sie das Budget und die damit verbundenen Kosten innerhalb der festgelegten Richtlinien; Entwickeln und implementieren Sie den Boutique-Aktionsplan mit der kaufmännischen Abteilung mit Schwerpunkt auf Geschäftsentwicklung; Sicherstellen des Umsatzwachstums; Marktanteil gewinnen; Überprüfung der Wettbewerbstrends, Empfehlung und Einleitung von Änderungen zur Maximierung der Ziele; Management: Festlegung, Umsetzung und Überwachung der Boutique-Verkaufsstrategie; Gewährleistung der Umsetzung und regelmäßigen Überwachung des Boutique-Aktionsplans (ergebnisorientiert, monatliche Überprüfung und Aktualisierung, Überwachung und Weiterverfolgung des Plans); Gewährleistung der Einhaltung aller Richtlinien und Verfahren durch regelmäßiges Ladenmanagement und Mitarbeiterbesprechungen, Durchlaufen von Geschäften, Audits ... Stellen Sie zusammen mit dem Visual Merchandising-Team sicher, dass die Standards für das Store-Image gemäß den Unternehmensrichtlinien eingehalten werden, und koordinieren Sie die ordnungsgemäße Schulung des Verkaufspersonals; Stellen Sie angemessene Warenbestände sicher; Sicherstellen der richtigen Kleidung, Pflege und Verhalten im Einklang mit den Richtlinien der Marke; Gewähren Sie die Einhaltung der von der Gruppe bereitgestellten betrieblichen Verfahren; Führen Sie mit gutem Beispiel und Teamgeist: Führen und motivieren Sie das Team, um das Verkaufsziel und die KPIs für den Einzelhandel zu erreichen und zu maximieren; Beaufsichtigen Sie die Pflege der Boutique; Behandeln Sie alle Anfragen und Beschwerden des Kunden; Customer Relations Management: Behandeln Sie den Kunden nach Markenstandards: Stellen Sie sicher, dass jeder Kunde hervorragende Standards, solides Produktwissen und alle anderen Komponenten des Kundenservice erhält; Handeln Sie als Markenbotschafter, wenn Sie die Marke bei Meetings, Veranstaltungen (lokal und international) und anderen arbeitsbezogenen Funktionen vertreten; Aufbau starker Kundenbeziehungen und Steigerung der Loyalität; Erwerb einer relevanten Kundendatenbank, Umwandlung in Verkaufstransaktion und Bindung des Kunden für zukünftige Transaktionen; Überwachen und Ausführen des Boutique-CRM-Programms; Teammanagement: Führt alle notwendigen Aufsichtsfunktionen aus, um das zugewiesene Personal effektiv und effizient zu verwalten: Stellen Sie das Boutique-Team in Bezug auf Projekte, Aufgaben und Operationen ein, leiten und fungieren Sie als Berater; Festlegung und Kommunikation der Missionen und Ziele aller Teammitglieder, wobei Prioritäten und angemessene Fristen klar festgelegt werden; Formulierung der Ziele und Ziele des Verkaufsteams, Motivation der Mitarbeiter und Verstärkung des Engagements; Motivieren Sie das Boutique-Team um die Strategie und Vision der Maison; Fördert ein kooperatives und harmonisches Arbeitsklima, um die Moral und Produktivität der Mitarbeiter zu maximieren; Handeln Sie als Coach und unterstützen Sie die Kollegen in Betrieb, Verkauf und Training; Job-Profil: Bachelor mit mindestens 10 Jahren Einzelhandelserfahrung, vorzugsweise in Luxus-Schmuck / Uhrmacherei-Sektor; Qualifizierung / Ausbildung in Uhren & Schmuck, Kenntnisse der Diamant-Grading und Design; Vorzugsweise mit Qualifikation in der Gemologie; MS Office Erfahrung erforderlich (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); fließend in Englisch und Französisch ist obligatorisch; Die Kenntnisse in einer anderen Sprache sind ein Plus (Arabisch, Chinesisch, Russisch, Italienisch); Persönliche Fähigkeiten: Führungsfähigkeiten und proaktiver Ansatz; Ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind erforderlich; Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu delegieren und zu verfolgen, um die Ausführung zu gewährleisten; Menschen freundlich und komfortabel Umgang mit VIP-Kunden; Hervorragende Repräsentationsfähigkeiten; Fokussiert, zielorientiert und organisiert; Starkes Verständnis der Kundendienstbedürfnisse und Kundenprioritäten (intern und extern);
